1003.original: You seem surprised. Did you not cross our gates in search of blood?

1004.original: Come hither, children of the dawn. The undying master will drink deep tonight!

1300.original: The guildhest is complete! Come and collect your reward.

1305.original: A fine display! Now come, collect your reward.

1306.original: Done, are we?<hex:02100103>Then haul your bloody arses over here so's we can leave this awful place!

1307.original: That was...adequate. Back to me, adventurer.

1308.original: You've a knack for this, haven't you? 'Twas as if I were watching myself, ten summers past!

1400.original: Defeat one enemy group at a time.

1401.original: If <hex:023110FF09424E70634E616D6503E802020203> spots you, he will order all remaining targets to attack. Stay out of his line of sight and tackle his minions one at a time.

1402.original: If <hex:023110FF09424E70634E616D6503E802020203> spots you, he will order all remaining targets to attack. Stay out of his line of sight and tackle his minions one at a time.

1403.original: Steady there! Only a fool with a death wish would engage both parties at once!

1405.original: Don't be so bloody eager to march headlong into peril! Try luring the beasts away from the goobbue without alarming the mossy lout.

1406.original: Executed to perfection! Now put the seedkin down!

1407.original: The goobbue has seen you and alerted his scrags! Slay as many as you can before jumpin' in bed with the giant, or you won't survive another bell!

1408.original: Get up! You won't do your allies any good lying sprawled across the grass like a beached whale!

1409.original: What in the seven hells are you fools doing!? Fall back and regroup!

1410.original: Might be I was mistaken about you all. I'd say your chances of victory are a notch above dismal.

1411.original: You've come this far, now finish him!

1500.original: When threatened, <hex:023110FF09424E70634E616D6503E802020203> will summon reinforcements. Stay alert!

1503.original: The stronger of your allies would be wise to draw the enemy's attention away from the weaker.

1504.original: Those allies specialized in dealing damage will find their attacks more effective when dealt from the enemy's flank or rear.

1506.original: Another wave! But unlike the last!

1600.original: Defeat <hex:023110FF09424E70634E616D6503E802030203> to open the first gate.

1601.original: Defeat the enemies and use the lever to open the gate.

1602.original: Defeat <hex:023110FF09424E70634E616D6503E802020203> before the yarzons break free.

1603.original: Behind you! Slay the lesser enemies before concentrating your efforts on the true threat.

1604.original: Pull the lever and open the gate!

1605.original: Quickly! Those boulders will not hold the yarzons back for long!

1606.original: There to the left of the gate! A second swarm of yarzons has appeared! Hurry and fell the gigantoad or you will have the vilekin to deal with, as well.

1607.original: A swarm of yarzons has broken through! Your attention is best focused on clearing away the six-legged vilekin before returning to the gigantoad.

1608.original: A second swarm approaches quickly! Ready yourselves!

1609.original: A superb display of strength and speed! Well done!

1610.original: The boulders are beginning to crack!

1611.original: The boulders will crumble at any moment, allowing the yarzons entry!

1612.original: Now pull the lever to open the gate...but only when you are ready for what waits on the other side.

1613.original: My orders are to aid you to victory. You only make it harder on yourselves by disregarding them.

1614.original: Now that those two are out of the way, concentrate your efforts on the hog.

1615.original: Something tells me there will be more if you cannot make swift work of that toad.

1616.original: The first gate is open! Tend to your wounds before advancing to the second.

1617.original: The second gate is open! One more, and you will have breached the gigantoad's lair.

1618.original: The third gate has fallen! The lord of the lair awaits beyond!

1619.original: The safety mechanism on the gate will deactivate once all threats in the area have been removed.

1701.original: Use fire sprite cores to light the herb patch and release slumber-inducing smoke into the air.

1702.original: Your orders are to capture the gil turtle. The best manner in which to accomplish this task is by first weakening the poor creature.

1703.original: The craven bandits who spirited away the turtle would not have you reclaim their prize, and will heal the creature's wounds with hopes that their efforts will discourage you into leaving. Draw the turtle away from the conjurers.

1704.original: In its current weakened state, the gil turtle will be unable to resist the effects of the herbs. Now quickly! We require fire sprite cores!

1705.original: Use the core to light the herb patch lying before me.

1706.original: The herbs are aflame! Now do what you must to draw the gil turtle into the smoke!

1707.original: And so the gentle giant succumbs to slumber's blissful embrace. Our work here is complete.

1708.original: Those efts may prove troublesome if left alone. Slay the wavekin before the situation becomes problematic.

1709.original: Out of cores? Well then claim new ones! You'd think that much was obvious!

1710.original: Stay your blades!<hex:02100103>The client specifically stated that he wished his pet returned alive!

1711.original: You blundering half-wits! Now what are we to tell Lord Adeledji!

1712.original: The smoke will have little effect on the turtle while in his current condition.

1713.original: Releasing the smoke now would be useless. I shall tend to the herbs while you see to the gil turtle.

1800.original: Lure enemies away from the ruptured pollen clusters before engaging them.

1801.original: Stay clear of the ruptured pollen clusters when engaging enemies.

1802.original: If inhaled the pollen will set fire to your lungs and sap your strength. Draw the creatures a safe distance from the noisome mist and then engage.

1803.original: Do not let down your guard. The battle has only just begun.

1804.original: It may take some coercing to draw that one from the mist.

1805.original: Leave the mist at once! You will need all your strength to defeat these horrors of the wood!

1806.original: Maneuver clear of the raining pollen clusters lest you find yourself caught in their mist!

1807.original: The wind! It carries away the mist! The Matron smiles upon us!

1809.original: The creature has left the pollen mist!<hex:02100103>Now is your chance! Strike it down!

1810.original: Your foe weakens with every blow you land! Do not let up!

1811.original: Yes! I do believe you have him! It won't be much longer now!

1900.original: Defeat the roaming bandits before engaging the stationary targets.

1902.original: Prevent the conjurers from healing their wounded companions.

1904.original: My wounds! Someone see to my wounds!

1906.original: Ware the scouts, for they will alert their brethren of your presence.

1907.original: The swarmpoint has summoned reinforcements! Locate them immediately!

1908.original: Their conjurers will spell your end. Silence the casters so that there are none who might heal the swarmpoint.

1909.original: Keep your eyes open for roaming bandits who will join the fray! Remember this when situating your battles.

1910.original: Without their conjurers to heal them, you should make quick work of the others.

1911.original: The swarmpoint is known for his unmatchable strength. Send your hardiest allies to bear the brunt of his might while the others slowly drain his vitality.

1912.original: Reinforcements!<hex:02100103>See to the conjurers before your efforts are rendered to naught.

1913.original: Another unit! You know what you must do!

1914.original: Not all their spellweavers are masters of the curative arts. Learn to distinguish the healers from the rest!

1915.original: Lo! There is a conjurer in your midst! Find the cur and slay him!

2000.original: Use the guild-issue items to your advantage.

2001.original: Take care not to succumb to the enfeebling effects of the charmed creatures' attacks.

2002.original: Beware the enfeebling properties of Briaxio's attacks.

2004.original: Beware! The foul poisons of these creatures will disrupt your humours and send your body into fits.

2005.original: Do not let the poisons overwhelm you! Use the time between battles to purge the toxins from your veins.

2006.original: Confirm that each of your allies knows his role. One misstep could mean a man poisoned, paralyzed...or worse!

2007.original: Use the spell Esuna to your advantage! And if that fails you, a good old antidote will often do the trick.

2008.original: Without an ally to draw his magicks away from the others, Briaxio will unleash his bane on all of you!

2009.original: Briaxio's followers have rushed to his aid! Send several of your allies to drive off the reinforcements while those remaining keep Briaxio under control.

2100.original: Destroy the goblins' makeshift barricades and continue up the Matron's Lethe.

2102.original: The goblins hide behind their barricades. You must destroy these obstacles to reach them. However, be always aware of their bombs.

2103.original: The bombs wielded by Stikflix Grumblytoss are much deadlier and have a greater blast radius than those used by his ragtag army.

2104.original: Remember your roles within the party and communicate with your allies. Those are the keys to victory!

2105.original: If a bomb is tossed your way, do not panic. Simply retreat until it detonates and then return to the front lines.

2106.original: I shall give the goblins credit where credit is due. It must have taken them a half-turn of the sun to drag these crates into place... Now demolish them!

2107.original: The first station is toppled, but another lies near the top of the heavenspillar. Forward, adventurers!

2108.original: The goblins' leader, Stikflix Grumblytoss, awaits ahead! Give him no quarter!

2109.original: Stikflix Grumblytoss may not appear to be the most formidable of foes, but his realm-shaking explosives make him a force to be reckoned with. If one happens to land in your vicinity, you would take my advice and run.

2200.original: Rotten jam will emerge from the stale bubbles if ignored. Burst them before they burst on their own.

2201.original: When burst, acid bubbles will emit a harmful, corrosive liquid. Avoid attacking them at all costs.

2202.original: Rotten jam! That's why I warned you to burst the stale bubbles. Now you have that <hex:021A020203>thing<hex:021A020103> to deal with!

2203.original: That wasn't so hard now, was it?

2204.original: What did the damn morbol do, pass wind!?<hex:02100103>See to the bubbles afore they see to you!

2205.original: I reckon you've done this before.<hex:02100103>That was some proper combat, if I do say so meself.

2206.original: What are you fixing to do? Get us all killed?

2207.original: Not another! Just the smell alone is enough to make a man retch! Do away with the thing, would you?

2208.original: The stale bubbles, not the acid bubbles, you mud-brained dullard!

2209.original: Send the damned thing back to the hell it slithered up from!

2211.original: Not the most pleasant buggers to fight, are they? Maybe next time you'll heed me words and burst the bubbles first.

2212.original: See the bastard's vines start to twitch? The creature grows weak!

2213.original: Leave them stale bubbles be, and from them'll drop a dollop of rancid ooze almost as foul as me ma's gruel. If you don't want to see that happen, burst the bubbles quick.

2300.original: Buso draws his strength from the blue flames. Extinguish the flames to make him more susceptible to your attacks.

2301.original: A new blue flame will appear where <hex:023110FF09424E70634E616D6502E802020203> is slain. Choose your battles.

2302.original: If you are branded with Buso's Mark of Pain, distance yourself from your allies so that they are not caught in the Dark Dome.

2303.original: Those horrible blue flames─they're the aetherial traces of slain voidsent. Our Lifestream won't have the stuff, so the essence remains trapped in the corporeal realm. Buso taps that essence...

2304.original: You cannot slay a void hound without it leaving behind a flame. If you are to cull the beasts, be ready to deal swiftly with the consequences of your actions.

2305.original: Buso readies the Mark of Pain! Once marked, you cannot escape the fate you are dealt...but you can spare your allies!

2306.original: Go! Smother the blue flames!<hex:02100103>It's the only way to see Buso weakened!

2307.original: Damn! Another blue flame is lit!<hex:02100103>Buso grows stronger every moment he basks in its unholy light!

2308.original: Rise up, adventurer!<hex:02100103>This battle is not yet lost! Remember the blue flames!

2309.original: Only one flame remains! Quickly! See it out!

2310.original: Now is your chance!<hex:02100103>Tear the fiend limb from limb...from limb from limb!

2311.original: Buso seeks to mark those allies who douse his flames!

2312.original: One of you has been marked!<hex:02100103>For Twelve's sake and the sake of the others, run!

2313.original: Thrust him back into the void!

2314.original: Draw Buso away from the blue flames before extinguishing them!

2403.original: Arrive in the heart of the Longstop

2405.original: Clear the Hall of the Cesti

2407.original: Clear the Hall of the Secutores

2505.original: The Lord of the Whorl shhhall sssup upon your sssouls!

2600.original: My flames shall consume thy flesh and soul both!

2602.original: Surrender thyself to the fires of judgment!

2603.original: Thy soul shall burn for eternity!

2704.original: MASTERS MUST PAY! MASTERS MUST DIE!

2906.original: Deactivate the level IV magitek field

3001.original: Avoid the invincible <hex:023110FF09424E70634E616D6504E802020203> and focus your attacks on the shadowclaw.

3002.original: Avoid the invincible <hex:023110FF09424E70634E616D6504E802020203> and focus your attacks on the shadowclaw.

3003.original: Avoid the invincible <hex:023110FF09424E70634E616D6504E802020203> and focus your attacks on the shadowclaw.

3004.original: <hex:022B16FF14023110FF09424E70634E616D6503E80202020303> is all you need be concerned with. Shut all else out.

3005.original: <hex:022B16FF14023110FF09424E70634E616D6502E80202020303>... Ware his attacks, but do not let the fiend lure you from your objective.

3006.original: <hex:022B16FF14023110FF09424E70634E616D6503E80203020303> wander 'twixt this realm and theirs, appearing only for a few moments. Pay them no heed, and they will pay you none in turn. Draw too close, and...

3007.original: Do not be lured in by <hex:023110FF09424E70634E616D6503E802020203>'s dance. Keep your distance and keep your head.

3008.original: Can you not see your blows to <hex:023110FF09424E70634E616D6503E802020203> have no effect? Avoid its attacks and concentrate your efforts on the shadowclaw.

3009.original: <hex:022B16FF14023110FF09424E70634E616D6503E80202020303>'s magicks can smother the field of battle. Stay light on your feet.

3010.original: Watch carefully. Order can be discovered in the shadows' movements, if you would but seek it.

3011.original: You are doing well. The beast weakens.

3012.original: There is little life left in this one, but do not let down your guard. The battle is far from over.

3013.original: Never before have I seen such mastery of the battlefield. You have far exceeded my expectations, adventurers.

3100.original: <hex:022B16FF14023110FF09424E70634E616D6503E80202020303> will appear once her subjects are slain.

3102.original: The servitors will self-destruct once approached. Either strike them from afar, or avoid them altogether.

3103.original: All rise for Her Royal Highness! When angered, the queen will order her remaining subjects to self-destruct. Do not get caught in the blast.

3104.original: The servitors will not hesitate to self-destruct. Steel your defenses!

3105.original: Bomb chars are just as quick to burst as the servitors. Fall back!

3106.original: There! To the rear! The bomb chars advance!

3107.original: There is no end to the bomb chars. Turn your eyes elsewhere.

3108.original: He who slumbers is doomed to bear the blast's full force. Silence the slimes, lest you succumb to the flames.

3109.original: The queen's subjects number in the thousands. You cannot dispel them all!

3110.original: The order has been given! Scatter!

3111.original: That was but one baronet amongst many. He may have fallen, but another will soon rise to replace him.

3112.original: Good! The life spills from <hex:023110FF09424E70634E616D6503E802020203> with every blow!

3113.original: When the queen falls, her subjects will be overtaken with grief and end their lives. Take care not to join them!

3114.original: Do not grow overconfident. While one candle gutters, still a hundred bonfires rage.

3115.original: How little the queen's baronets value their own lives. In a sense, they are the perfect subjects.

3116.original: The queen will not step down from her throne so easily.

3117.original: Sound the bells! The queen is dead!

3200.original: All five <hex:023110FF09424E70634E616D6504E802030203> must be defeated simultaneously.

3201.original: Listen carefully if you want to live. <hex:022B16FF14023110FF09424E70634E616D6502E80202020303> will not stay dead for long. Allow his dark brothers but a moment, and they'll drag the fallen back from the gates of the seventh hell.

3203.original: Make ready! The camios seek to regroup!

3206.original: The Wall of Naught! The camios seek a new victim!

3207.original: The Black Cross renders a single camio invincible. Ignore him and focus your attacks on the rest!

3208.original: The Demon's Sword! The burden on your front line will be great. Healers, do not fail your allies!

3209.original: Something rises from the Pit! Do not falter!

3210.original: Their foul magicks protect him! Your attacks amount to naught!

3211.original: As long as one cannot be harmed, you will never be able to destroy the lot!

3212.original: One is down. Quickly! Finish the others!

3213.original: You see? Slaying one is of no use! You must defeat all five at once if the day is to be yours!

3214.original: The camio draws strength from the Demon's Sword. He will tear your front line apart!

3215.original: Follow the camio's eyes! Draw them away from your spell casters!

3216.original: Do not waste your efforts on the one who cannot be harmed!

3218.original: Rid the playing field of our new guest!

3219.original: Back to the task at hand, lads!

3220.original: Show them only as much mercy as they would show you! None!

3221.original: You've done it! They can no longer escape their dark demesne!

3300.original: Protect the Allagan artifacts from the quarreling gigants.

3301.original: Defeat the leaders to prevent the summoning of reinforcements.

3302.original: Hurry to the foot of the hill! The artifacts will not protect themselves!

3303.original: They're fighting amongst themselves! Let them bloody each other's noses before coming in to wipe up the mess!

3304.original: Small units approach! Keep them off the artifacts!

3305.original: Gigants from multiple sides! You'll need to divide your strength if the artifacts are to be saved!

3306.original: The gigas leader, Crius! He will summon his minions if not put to the sword!

3307.original: Giants to the east! Stop them before they can make the approach!

3308.original: Hecatoncheires to the south! Slaying them might just anger their leader onto the battlefield!

3309.original: Thal's balls! Both giant <hex:021A020203>and<hex:021A020103> hecatoncheir leaders make for the artifacts!

3310.original: Damnation! Keep the leaders away from one another! It will only serve to worsen matters!

3311.original: The gigants swing their weapons with reckless abandon! Draw them from the artifacts so as to prevent any collateral damage!

3312.original: The gigas leader flees! Now is your chance! Run the bastard through!

3313.original: The giant leader falls back... Something is amiss!

3314.original: That is not the back of a fleeing man! The hecatoncheir leads you into a trap!

3315.original: More gigants take the field, and will continue to do so until you have seen their leaders slain!

3316.original: Not a single scratch on any of the artifacts. I wouldn't believe it if I hadn't seen it with mine own eyes!

3317.original: All the artifacts remain! The Sons of Saint Coinach will be pleased!

3318.original: Two artifacts remain standing. See that they are not destroyed!

3319.original: A single artifact remains! You cannot allow it to be lost!

3320.original: The leaders have yet to take the field, but could arrive at any moment. Stay alert!

3321.original: Without an enemy to strike, the gigants have turned their fury on the artifacts!

3500.original: Clear the Oratory of Tatamefu II

3501.original: Clear the Rosarium of Lalafuto I

3502.original: Clear the Adytum of Lalafuto IV

3509.original: A statuette has already been placed.

3600.original: I will suffer none to oppose Lord van Baelsar!

3601.original: My shields are impregnable! Join the countless challengers who have dashed themselves against them!

3602.original: Your defeat will bring Lord van Baelsar's noble conquest one step closer to fruition!

3603.original: Ungh... Though it cost me my life...I <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> strike you down!

3700.original: Heehee HAHA hahaha HEEHEE haha HEEEEEE!!!

3701.original: Soon you will see the depths of your folly, mortals!

3703.original: There is no escape! No hope! NONE!!!

3800.original: Sons of man! Murderers of my children!

3801.original: For thee my hatred is unending, unyielding!

3802.original: Tremble before the might of the earth!

3803.original: To the last, I grapple with thee!

3804.original: I shall grind thee beneath my heel, mortal!

3805.original: Hie, my children, into the dark! <hex:02080CE905FF04536865FF03486503> will not be denied...

3806.original: I'm here... I'm here... I'm here...

3807.original: Mother... Father... I can't... I can't find you...

3810.original: I said I'd come! I said I'd come!<hex:02100103>I'm here... I'm here... I'm here...

3811.original: Where are you... Where are you...

3908.original: Stand back! I'm going to blast open the bulkhead!

3909.original: This might take a while! Watch my back!

3910.original: I'm almost there! Keep that thing occupied!

3911.original: Come, <hex:021A020203>hero<hex:021A020103>, show me what you can do. Show me...<hex:021A020203>everything<hex:021A020103>!

3913.original: You will <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> take any more from me!

3914.original: The pain I have suffered, I shall visit upon you a hundredfold!

3917.original: Noooooo! I will not lose...to the likes of <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>!

3918.original: Damn it, that colossus is enhanced! Hold on─I'll try to think of something!

4008.original: You'll need proper firepower to blast through that. Try and find another path to the armor bay.

4009.original: There ought to be an identification key reader nearby. You need to complete pilot registration before you can activate an armor.

4010.original: Well, well, would you look at this! I've found just the unit for you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

4011.original: I'll send the identification data to the terminal. You can use that to activate her.

4012.original: I have taken the liberty of preparing an <hex:021A020203>electrifying<hex:021A020103> stage for you.

4013.original: Meet one of my creations. You might find it a <hex:021A020203>handful<hex:021A020103>.

4014.original: I will lay Garlond low, but first I must break you!

4015.original: <pant> I will not suffer...to be in another's shadow!

4016.original: Let us dance, champion of Eorzea.

4019.original: The Ultima Weapon has partaken of the power of eikons! None can stand against it!

4020.original: Hearken unto me, crystal bearer. Thy foe is Darkness clad in steel.

4021.original: If thou wouldst triumph, thou must look to the Light.

4023.original: Garuda's essence...torn from the Ultima Weapon!?

4027.original: Nooo! How...how are you doing this!?

4028.original: We settle this once and for all!

4029.original: I need not the power of eikons to defeat you!

4030.original: This is most...unexpected. You are possessed of great might, this I will allow.

4031.original: Yet yours is not the might of a ruler! Such is the difference between us─a difference that will assure my victory!

4033.original: How much destruction must be wreaked before you are sated!?

4034.original: I have not the strength...to shield thee again...

4035.original: Permit not the manifestation of that vile magick...lest Darkness prevail!

4036.original: Your time is at an end, Hydaelyn!

4037.original: From the deepest pit of the seven hells to the very pinnacle of the heavens, the world shall tremble! Unleash Ultima!

4038.original: Ahahahaha! You are strong, Warrior of Light!

4039.original: Yet know that if I should perish, so too will the mortal within whose flesh I reside.

4040.original: Now make your choice and live with it! Muahahahahaha!

4041.original: Mark not the Dark Minion's subtle words.

4042.original: Only Light may banish the Darkness.

4043.original: Receive of me this power, my child, and raise thy Crystal aloft!

4100.original: Gain access to the exploratory site

4607.original: Broken...a cry...dreams of glory...come to die...♪

4610.original: Urggghhh! I'll gut any of ye what lays a hand on me muse!

4611.original: Scurvy dogs... Ye know not love! Aggghhh...

4612.original: L-Land!? Land ho! Diamanda, I've come...urgh...home...

4805.original: Biggy is big! Biggy is strong!<hex:02100103>No one stands up to Biggy!

4807.original: Biggy has only begun to fight!

4808.original: Biggy is small, but Biggy's heart is big!

4810.original: YOU KILL MY SON?<hex:02100103>I KILL YOU!

4900.original: Hearken unto me, brave Mogglesguard! These villains shall threaten you no more!

4901.original: Lend me your strength, and I shall purge our enemies from Thornmarch!

4902.original: You shall suffer for your transgressions against my subjects!

4903.original: Hold fast, Mogglesguard! Together we shall cast them out!

4904.original: Mogglesguard, to arms! Your king has need of you!

4905.original: Receive of my body, Mogglesguard! Let my strength become yours!

4906.original: Begone, pomless ones! Torment my subjects no more!

5003.original: Slake my hunger and know true glory!

5004.original: I shall feast upon your very soul!

5006.original: Your souls are mine at last!

5100.original: This way lies the first stage! By way of a warm-up, your opponents will be beasts and mammets!

5102.original: The second stage begins! Gird your loins for a <hex:021A020203>beastly<hex:021A020103> encounter!

5104.original: You have done well to come this far, but the hardest trials are yet to come. In the third stage, you must clash steel with seasoned gladiators!

5112.original: And so we arrive at the climactic ending! Victory belongs to the beauteous!

5113.original: You may be able to stand with the best of the bloodsands, but how will you fare against the mightiest thaumaturge of the age?

5114.original: There is no escaping the Absolute Bind!

5116.original: Run, my pretties, lest you feel the searing kiss of my magicks!

5200.original: You trespass upon my domain, tainted of the Light!

5201.original: Drink deep of the sea's bitter draught!

5202.original: Mine is the power to cleanse all things! Naught can withstand the relentless onslaught of my waves!

5203.original: You challenge me with trickery? Fools! Your mortal contrivances cannot quell the raging sea!

5204.original: My waters...are stilled... This...this is the blessing of Light?

5206.original: Your flesh shall feed my minions of the deep!

5305.original: Knowings of cheesemake is gobbie secret!

5306.original: All cheese recipes are belong to Illuminati!

5307.original: Shkoh! Target is eyecatched! All hands, forcetake Brayflox!

5308.original: Illuminati brainfruit is frontmost! Uplanders have no chance to survive!

5403.original: Who dares set foot within my domain? The wretched white mages of Amdapor?

5404.original: To face me is to face thy deepest, darkest nightmares!

5405.original: Not even in eternal sleep shalt thou be free from the terror of my weaving!

12313.original: Well, I weren't expectin' that. Still...made for interestin' viewin', I must say. From now on, though, you'll be up against the Maelstrom's best.

12315.original: <hex:021A020203>If<hex:021A020103>, aye. But I suppose it's too late to back out now... I say we move in tandem and try to overwhelm them.

12317.original: Forgive me, Brother. I couldn't keep up...

12318.original: Knights o' the Barracuda, to your positions!

12319.original: No doubt you've heard tales of our skill at arms, adventurer. And now you shall witness it firsthand.

12320.original: Seven hells... To think I spoke of <hex:021A020203>our<hex:021A020103> skill at arms...

12323.original: <pant> <pant> I yield! I yield!<hex:02100103>By the Navigator... <pant> <pant><hex:02100103>That was...<hex:021A020203>inspirational<hex:021A020103>!

12325.original: We'll do our best not to gut ye, darlin', but once we taste blood, well...<hex:021A020203>old 'abits die 'ard<hex:021A020103>.

12326.original: Tsk-tsk. Didn't nobody ever tell ye the 'ells 'ave no fury like a Siren scorned? Yer gizzard won't be fit fer the chum bucket when we're through with ye!

12332.original: Like that, is it? PAH! All guns! Bombard the bilge-swillin' scrags!

12333.original: Now <hex:021A020203>that's<hex:021A020103> a 'venturer after me own 'eart!<hex:02100103>That lust for blood... Oooh, it sets me skin atingle.

12334.original: Bested the Sirens already? Why, Rhoswen would scarce have had time to swear herself hoarse.

12335.original: Dear me... Did the Sirens keep you so long? Mayhap you were loath to strike them for fear you might catch something...?

12336.original: No matter. I am come to test the worth of the Krakens' newest acquisition. I trust you will oblige me...?

12337.original: You will be <hex:021A020203>shocked<hex:021A020103> to hear that she prefers her prey roasted. Rather sophisticated for a savage beast, wouldn't you say?

12338.original: You seem to be keeping up with her quite well─thus far, at least. Did I mention that Ymir has hidden talents?

12339.original: Hmph. 'Twould seem I wasted my coin. Very well. Victory is yours. Be on your way.

12340.original: I, Eynzahr Slafyrsyn, shall be your final opponent.

12341.original: Couldn't help myself, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>. Those last few matches stirred something...

12343.original: Spare me, Admiral. I hold my duty to the Maelstrom above all else─as you well know. Nevertheless, I will not deny that this uniform now prevents me from doing my worst.

12344.original: But since all here present are privy to the truth, might we not loosen the collar and hearken back to the glory days, just this once? ...By your leave, o' course.

12345.original: As you like. 'Twill make for a better spectacle.

12346.original: Heh. I said I'd never don you again, old friend. But many a man would trade the wisdom of years for a minute of youthful hubris...

12409.original: Kupopo... That's enough... You've made your point.<hex:02100103>This isn't a fight to the death, kupo...

12410.original: Thou hast weathered my trial thus far...but I am not convinced.<hex:02100103>I will try thy limits.

12411.original: Nidhogg will spare thee no clemency.<hex:02100103>And thus neither must I.

12412.original: ...Thy resolve hath withstood my scrutiny.<hex:02100103>Mayhap there is hope to be had in one such as thee...

12413.original: Fight on, warrior! Press thy attack!

12414.original: Thou art formidable...<hex:02100103>But canst thou endure until the bitter end?

12415.original: Come, warrior. Show me what strength doth remain in thy frail mortal shell!

12416.original: The sky is the domain of dragons.<hex:02100103>How wilt thou contend with such mastery?

12417.original: Thou art formidable...<hex:02100103>But canst thou endure until the bitter end?

12418.original: Fight on, warrior! Press thy attack!

12419.original: ...Thy resolve hath withstood my scrutiny.<hex:02100103>Mayhap there is hope to be had in one such as thee...

12502.original: The legatus himself is here!<hex:02100103>After him!

12503.original: I shall contend with this foe.<hex:02100103>Press onwards, my comrades!

12510.original: My weapon's inhibitors exist for a reason...<hex:02100103>But I will not lose to you again!

12511.original: Magitek enhances my bladework tenfold!<hex:02100103>You cannot hope to win!

12512.original: Forgive me... I thought myself stronger...

12513.original: Mine eyes grow dim...<hex:02100103>Whither now the Light...?

12514.original: Ugh... I am no warrior, it seems...

12516.original: The Garleans strike for the heart of the facility.<hex:02100103>And the legatus spearheads their charge.

12517.original: We must be swift in our pursuit.

12518.original: Go! I will stand guard over Mistress Krile.<hex:02100103>You must keep the legatus from his prize!

12519.original: We leave her in your care, then.<hex:02100103>You'd best keep her safe, Unukalhai!

12520.original: The central laboratory should be up ahead.<hex:02100103>Let's hurry along, shall we?

12600.original: Wriggling maggots! I shall grind you to paste in my jaws!

12601.original: Come, my children!<hex:02100103>Claim the vengeance that is rightfully yours!

12602.original: Look upon the fool who dared embrace my power!<hex:02100103>Witness the darkened wings that beat about his shriveled soul!

12603.original: Champions of man! Hearken to my fury!

12605.original: Brood-brother, thou hast doomed me...<hex:02100103>But if I must meet mine end, then all shall burn upon my pyre!

12607.original: All will perish!<hex:02100103>All will be consumed by fiery ruin!

12608.original: Thou hast survived my song...<hex:02100103>Curse thee and thine eye, Hraesvelgr!

12609.original: Will you flee, little mortals?<hex:02100103>My talons shall rend your courage; my jaws, taste agony!

12707.original: My dear Yafaem...<hex:02100103>What a wretched morass it has become.

12708.original: Do you spy that wreckage up ahead?<hex:02100103>Could it be one of the Talons' downed vessels?

12709.original: Is this not a tributary of the White Maiden?<hex:02100103>We should come upon Mhach if we follow it downstream!

12710.original: <cough> <splutter> I am not terribly fond of water...

12711.original: We aim for that pyramidal structure, but ware the voidsent.<hex:02100103>The air is thick with their otherworldly stench...

12712.original: Ah, the wonders of Mhachi architecture.<hex:02100103>Fifteen centuries and a flood later, and still it stands.

12713.original: Barring our way is a terrible sphere that has devoured entire cities.<hex:02100103>We must prove the stronger if we are to reach the Nullstone.

12714.original: This is it: the Tomb of the Nullstone.<hex:02100103>There will be a guardian. There is always a guardian...

12715.original: Gaha! There were <hex:021A020203>more<hex:021A020103> of you blood-filled morsels!?<hex:02100103>How well I will sup this day!

12716.original: Nasty little insects!<hex:02100103>You will not scurry so within my web!

12717.original: Bah! Not strong enough! Not strong enough!<hex:02100103>I must feed on more than flesh!

12718.original: Are you frightened, my precious prey?<hex:02100103>Gaze into my eyes and know true terror!

12719.original: What manner of prey...bites back?<hex:02100103>I must warn...Lord Forgall...

12720.original: Ah, some of you survived. How convenient.<hex:02100103>I am in need of fresh souls to shatter the ward.

12721.original: <cough> After so long...I am arisen...<hex:02100103>I will not...be buried here...

12722.original: Even empty husks have their uses.<hex:02100103>See how they jerk and dance at my command!

12723.original: I will teach those who oppose me the extent of their folly...

12724.original: Your pitiful lives will be mine in due time.<hex:02100103>But first, you must be punished for your insolence!

12725.original: Solitude weakens the spirit and warps the flesh...<hex:02100103>Stray from the pack at your peril!

12726.original: Will you glimpse the realm that awaits you after death?<hex:02100103>Drink deep from the chalice of oblivion!

12727.original: Ah, how sweet the rancid breeze of the underhells...<hex:02100103>Its winds will strip you to the bone!

12728.original: Arise, my rotting playthings!<hex:02100103>The board needs more pieces in play!

12729.original: My undead toys are so easily broken.<hex:02100103>Mayhap my minions will prove the sturdier...

12730.original: How tiresome. I had thought to spare my energies for the ward.<hex:02100103>But you insist on gripping to life so very tightly...

12731.original: Embrace your fate! By my stygian light be your doom revealed!

12732.original: My lord warned that mortals of power might interfere...<hex:02100103>But you are no threat to me! I reign in the court of the void!

12733.original: Know your slayer, intruders. I am Calofisteri, and by the blood of voidsent have I ascended to the sublime...

12734.original: Behold my magnificent mane!<hex:02100103>These curls are blades that cut, and roots that drain!

12735.original: Shall I share my luscious locks with you?

12736.original: Unkempt thieves! Slovenly marauders!<hex:02100103>You will not have the Nullstone!

12737.original: Have you ever witnessed such coifed perfection!?<hex:02100103>The edges of my tresses are sharper than swords!

12738.original: ...Why do you yet stand? I have supped on the void!<hex:02100103>What ungodly power swims in <hex:021A020203>your<hex:021A020103> veins?

12739.original: Yahahahaha!<hex:02100103>My strands will soak in the lifeblood of every last one of you!

12740.original: Do you dare face the halo of my unleashed glory?<hex:02100103>Or turn your back and risk the sting of my rejection?

12741.original: My pride is clipped... My strength is shorn...<hex:02100103>The Nullstone is yours...

12742.original: Weevils and maggots!<hex:02100103>I shall spin another web! Yes! More threads to bind you!

12743.original: See what you have done!<hex:02100103>My poor web is in tatters!

12744.original: Why must you wriggle so!<hex:02100103>You've ruined another web!

12745.original: Body of rock, from rough stone hewn...<hex:02100103>Chipped with chisel and marked by rune...

12746.original: Mind of spells, engraved instruction...<hex:02100103>Given life to wreak destruction...

12747.original: Core of arcane will ignited...<hex:02100103>Made to crush the uninvited...

12748.original: Departing now, the maker's spark...<hex:02100103>A shattered face, stone eyes grown dark...

12910.original: The <hex:020814E4E80202FF066669727374FF077365636F6E6403> untrapped box is hidden in a room ending with the number <hex:022003E80303>.

12914.original: Well done, well done! But let us see how you fare with this next task!

12915.original: I see your minds are yet unbroken. One final game, then, to test the limits of your courage!

12916.original: An impressive performance. You shall have your reward, as promised!

12917.original: Your resilience is astounding. Here, take your cookies!

12918.original: But be warned, brave ones: we shall not be so gentle on your next visit!

12919.original: There are six pumpkin chests hidden around the manor. Find them all to win the game!

12920.original: Can you find and open the pumpkin coffer? You'll need to call out five numbers to dispel the lock...

12921.original: Five little numbers...hiding here and there...

12922.original: I have scribed eldritch patterns on the floors of four rooms.

12923.original: Only when a mortal stands within each circle will I release you from this task!

12924.original: Scoop up the smoldering coals and light the jack-o'-lanterns!

12925.original: You must ignite four before the clock ticks down!

12926.original: Scour the manor for baskets and claim the treats they hold!

12927.original: Some baskets hold more and some hold less. Can you find fifteen cookies in time?

12928.original: Creep around the manor and find the untrapped boxes!

12929.original: Only two are safe, and there are clues to guide you. You <hex:021A020203>could<hex:021A020103> try trusting your gut, of course...

12930.original: Pumpkins abound, but only one is a transformed impostor!

12931.original: Make use of the smoke bombs, and look for that telltale blue...

12932.original: Welcome to our haunted manor! Complete three of my terrifying tasks, and you shall have a reward!

12941.original: This meter is shared by the entire party. Once it reaches zero, you will be ejected from the instance.

13012.original: Upon sliver of Her glory, we now call! Squaaawk! Squaaawk!

13014.original: O Lady of the Vortex! In Your name, our lives we give...

13015.original: To the goddess, all glory! All creation, Her dominion is!

13016.original: From wrath of mighty Garuda, reprieve there is not! Squaaawk!

13101.original: Daughter, be the bearer of my wisdom.

13102.original: Know you the full weight of death.

13104.original: Even in death there is no release.

13106.original: I would know the weight of your souls.

13108.original: I shall tip back the balance...

13109.original: Sin must be balanced with suffering.

13302.original: We've come too far, sacrificed too much to stop now!

13303.original: You think you are the only ones to have known sorrow!?

13304.original: No, NO! We will not be denied so easily!

13305.original: You heard the man! Leave the fighting to us!

13306.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! The ranger! You must stop her!

13307.original: The fate of two worlds hangeth in the balance, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Quickly, thine aether!

13310.original: Trying to beat us at our own game? Hah!

13312.original: Go to her, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! We will deal with the others!

13313.original: I've...I've given her all I can. The rest is up to you!

13314.original: Caution, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! You mustn't channel so much at once!

13316.original: Is this...the power of the Echo!?

13317.original: Again they rise! Have these warriors no limits!?

13318.original: We'll hold the line, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, but you must...you must...

13319.original: Unto her blade we render our aether, that fortune may favor us this day...

13321.original: This has gone on long enough! J'rhoomale─kill the girl!

13325.original: 'Tis done! With this blade I banish the darkness!

13333.original: That's it, that's it! We've got them!

13504.original: Pssshkoh... Lamebrix will flatten uplanders like crawlybug!

13708.original: You, who would inherit the future... You have proven yourself...worthy.

13709.original: My faithful... To the past with you, to free these ones from the prison of time...

13802.original: Arrive in the Astrology and Astromancy Camera

13803.original: Clear the Astrology and Astromancy Camera

13805.original: You are unwelcome here. This you know...yet your thirst for knowledge brings you nonetheless. I would be happy to oblige!

13806.original: Yes, I believe this is the perfect volume for you...

13807.original: What's this one? “Theories on the Existence of River Imps”...? That's piqued my interest!

13808.original: Behold this collection of grimoires of legend! Feel their power and puissance, and let it fill you with rapturous pleasure...then DIE!

13809.original: Your thirst for knowledge is still not sated? Then take this tome! And this one! Take ALL of them!

13900.original: This conflict was foreordained, you know. All is laid out upon the Wheel of Fate, free from the meddling hands of mortals.

13901.original: Denizens of the abyss! From ink of blackest night, I summon you! Darkness to me!

13902.original: Bring death to blood and flesh, destroy demented demons all!

13903.original: Ah...yesss... So <hex:021A020203>this<hex:021A020103> is the Dark! I am becoming one with you now... It is... It is ecstasy! Yes! The Dark has chosen me! The bodies of the unwitting will be my vessels! I am immortal...

14006.original: I'll give you a glorious end, Warrior of Light!<hex:02100103>Come! See what awaits you at the far edge of fate!

14108.original: There it is up ahead─the island from the tome!<hex:02100103>Let's find somewhere to dock this behemoth!

14109.original: These buildings were meant to house the refugees of Mhach.<hex:02100103>A promised land, forgotten by time...

14110.original: ...The voidsent have claimed this place, just as I suspected.<hex:02100103>It is become a nest of shadows and despair.

14111.original: The Queen's Coffin, rent in twain!<hex:02100103>Scathach is already awoken, then...

14112.original: By the twitching of my whiskers, there is fell magick ahead.<hex:02100103>Only the queen herself could radiate malice of this magnitude!

14113.original: Insolent mortals...<hex:02100103>One does not come uninvited to the Shadow Queen's castle!

14114.original: Forgive me, my queen...<hex:02100103>This wretched wraith has failed you...

14115.original: Oh, how I love entertaining unexpected guests!<hex:02100103>And do I spy some familiar faces in the crowd!?

14116.original: Alas, we come to the end of my show...<hex:02100103>There shall be...no encore...

14117.original: Welcome, mortals, to my citadel of shadows.<hex:02100103>Have you come to deepen the gloom with an offering of souls?

14118.original: Such pervasive light...<hex:02100103>It doth steal into the darkest corners, and chase away my shadows...

14119.original: You expect the creature I was before, enfeebled by confinement?<hex:02100103>Hah! Face me now in the fullness of my power!

14120.original: Shall I thrust open the gate to the void?<hex:02100103>The night hounds slaver at the scent of your fear...

14121.original: Another rift... Another chance to test your might?

14122.original: Not even in eternal sleep shall you be free from the terror of my weaving!

14123.original: The energies of the nether will be mine!<hex:02100103>I will bathe in primordial darkness!

14124.original: Bow before the shrieking majesty of the void!

14125.original: What have you done!?<hex:02100103>You seek to wrest from me control of the portal?

14126.original: So be it. A contest of strength, then!<hex:02100103>A contest you have no hope of winning.

14127.original: Impossible! I am a lord of the void, you cannot─<hex:02100103>Aaarrrggghhh!

14128.original: <pant> <pant> Mine imprisonment...weakened me more than I imagined...

14129.original: But you have not bested me yet!<hex:02100103>Witness now my true purpose for seeking the queen's rebirth!

14130.original: Yes. The glory! An infinite well of shadow!<hex:02100103>You have breached Scathach's unholy vessel, and released her power unto me!

14131.original: From the depths of shadow's well shall rise your ruination!

14132.original: Must I entreat the very specter of death to be rid of you!?<hex:02100103>I care not! I will wager all for your destruction!

14133.original: What more must I have...?<hex:02100103>How great the flood of darkness...to drown out your light...

14134.original: Creeping shade and silhouette, gather unto me!

14135.original: To me, my protégé!<hex:02100103>Smother these intruders with the arts that I have taught thee!

14136.original: And still you refuse to dim and submit...<hex:02100103>Must I try a different tact?

14137.original: Your fate was sealed the moment you set foot in my domain!

14138.original: From a chrysalis of light shall I birth the deepest shadow...

14139.original: Accept my touch, and bask in tenebrous brilliance!

14142.original: Systems check complete. Initializing armageddon sequence...

14143.original: Aetheromagnetic induction beacon active. Commencing aether transfer.

14156.original: Reactor capacity exceeded. Gravitational collapse imminent.

14157.original: You will not disturb Her Majesty!

14158.original: Beloved queen... I was not fit to cower in your shadow...

14159.original: Reaping winds, heed my command!<hex:02100103>Strip the souls from their worthless shells!

14160.original: I see the blossoms of your fragile lives...<hex:02100103>I need but reach forth and pluck them from their stems!

14161.original: Come closer, come closer!<hex:02100103>I promise I will give you a show to <hex:021A020203>die<hex:021A020103> for!

14163.original: This tiresome battle hath dragged on overlong. Enough.

14164.original: What's this? Visitors to our fair abode?<hex:02100103>Pray allow me to be the first to <hex:021A020203>welcome<hex:021A020103> you!

14165.original: Pay attention, or you'll miss the big reveal!

14166.original: Where is the laughter? The thunderous applause?<hex:02100103>There is simply no pleasing you!

14167.original: Dance with me! Prance with me! Choose your stage!<hex:02100103>A fiery demise or a watery grave!

14168.original: Shall we begin?<hex:02100103>Let dominion of your precious skies be decided here and now!

14169.original: And thus the Shadow Queen doth fall.<hex:02100103>I commend you on your victory.

14170.original: Yes, such skill and strength are deserving of a more fitting stage.<hex:02100103>Come, mortals─the true master of shadows awaiteth you...

14171.original: Something comes...but it is no voidsent!<hex:02100103>Be ready for anything!

14172.original: Shadow itself shall be mine armor!<hex:02100103>Come! Strike your feeble blows in vain!

14173.original: Such defenses will be difficult to pierce...<hex:02100103>But mind not his boasts! A persistent assault will prevail!

14200.original: Er...I may have misjudged the enemy.<hex:02100103>They should've been staining the soles of my boots by now...

14201.original: What are you fools gawping at!?<hex:02100103>Don't just stand there─your captain is in danger!

14208.original: Hey! You can't just run off!

14209.original: Deserting a battle is punishable by death!

14210.original: I order you to stand your ground!<hex:02100103>Come back here now! ...Please?

14215.original: Grrr... Damn it all to the seventh hell!<hex:02100103>I'll kill you bastards if it's the last thing I do!

14216.original: ...Y-You haven't seen the last of me!<hex:02100103>Mark my words! It'll be <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> who rues this day!!!

14217.original: I'll stomp these worms into the dust myself!<hex:02100103>This is <hex:021A020203>my<hex:021A020103> fight, understand? Stay out of it!

14220.original: Defeat imperial soldiers with the <hex:021A020203>Red Baron<hex:021A020103>

14222.original: For every yapping cur I strike down, another takes his place!

14223.original: How many soldiers did he bring with him!?

14225.original: Did you hear th─ Whoa! Watch out for that big one!

14226.original: Ware the colossus!<hex:02100103>It means to destroy itself and us along with it!

14227.original: Hah, you have felled a titan!<hex:02100103>But that still only counts as one!

14228.original: I will handle these soldiers!<hex:02100103>Pray dispose of the giant!

14230.original: The colossi are scrap, and the captain hits <hex:021A020203>us<hex:021A020103> as often as the enemy!<hex:02100103>Enough! Time for a tactical withdrawal!

14300.original: Initiating final disengagement sequence.<hex:02100103>All non-combat personnel are advised to evacuate.

14301.original: Mine age of slumber is at an end.

14302.original: A thousand thousand suns may set...

14303.original: But the insult of mine imprisonment...

14304.original: Hath been etched upon mine eternal memory.

14305.original: I am come to mete out justice.

14306.original: To bestow the blessings of victory unending.

14308.original: He who standeth above all other gods.

14309.original: He who shall bring slaughter and ruin!

14310.original: Disengagement sequence complete.<hex:02100103>Subject: Zurvan is released from containment.

14311.original: Good and evil, the war eternal...

14312.original: The fires of anger roar and howl...

14315.original: By sorrow's chill doth all become ice...

14316.original: I am beyond your petty morality!

14317.original: Death's gaze is fixed upon you...

14320.original: Frozen in time, mine armor of flame.<hex:02100103>Unto eternity's end, my righteous reign!

14322.original: What manner of mortals withstand such punishment?<hex:02100103>By battle, then, shall your fate be decided!

14323.original: Stubbornly doth mine enemy cling to life...<hex:02100103>But soon shall I loosen that hold!

14324.original: Graven in flesh, the brand is awoken...<hex:02100103>Suffer in endless torment!

14325.original: Hath mine equivocation cost me this contest!?

14505.original: Ugh... Naught for it but to fight!

14508.original: Heh heh heh... I've been waiting for you...

14509.original: Ramble... Ramble... Ramble with me all through the night...

14510.original: Down... Down... Down into the depths and to your death...

14511.original: So spirited... But if you will not serve, then you will suffer...

14512.original: Island, dead ahead! All hands, brace for impact!

14513.original: We appear to have arrived at our destination...<hex:02100103>Care to go and greet our hosts, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

14515.original: Watch out, there's more of them!

14516.original: Island, dead ahead! All hands, brace for impact!

14517.original: Seems we've arrived... Go on and greet our hosts─the rest of us will patch up the ship!

14605.original: One legendary monk trained by fighting coeurls.

14606.original: Another coeurl! It seems rather angry, doesn't it?

14607.original: Did you know Ivon Coeurlfist used a pair of Sphairai crafted fists shaped like coeurls?

14608.original: The monks used that golem to test their speed. It is called “Arbuda.”

14611.original: Your performance still leaves something to be desired.

14615.original: Only Coeurlfist himself has matched the time you just registered...

14618.original: You are quite the fighter.<hex:02100103>Let us see if you can handle this!

14619.original: The time has come to open all my chakra!

14620.original: Taste the power of the coeurl!

14622.original: I have never met one so strong as you.

14623.original: A stronger warrior I have not seen!

19516.original: Suffused with night, I shall prevail!

19520.original: Reaping crescent!<hex:02100103>A sweeping doom, striking from darkness!

20911.original: And where might you be off to?

20913.original: The Beoulve youth guides your fate, but have you the faith to fulfill his legacy?

20914.original: Well fought, champion. I leave you now to your quest. My Ovelia awaits...

20918.original: Bend to my will!<hex:02100103>An inescapable prison awaits!

20923.original: Seven shadows cast, seven fates foretold. Yet at the end of the broken path lies death, and death alone.

20925.original: They who dwell aloft have spoken. Let their words echo in your empty soul. Ruination is come!

20926.original: The dreams of men are fleeting, yet they must be embraced if they are to flourish. Have you the faith to do as much?

20928.original: O, divine light! Send us from our sins!

20929.original: Raise your shields against the falling light!

20930.original: Raise your swords against the coming night!

20931.original: You shall rue the day you raised your eyes to the heavens.

20934.original: O darkest of vessels! You are my sword! You are my rain!

20936.original: To maintain order, one must first have control.

20937.original: Honed is the blade that severs the villain's head. Endless is the path that leads him from hell.

20939.original: It is time to end this!

20941.original: Simmer does the light of life before rising to the heavens in a cleansing conflagration of divine benevolence.

20943.original: Only we can shield you from doom! To me, heroes! To me!

20946.original: The barrier will not last! We must stop her!

20950.original: Now is not the time to stay our blades!

20952.original: Children of Hydaelyn! Make it swift! You are Her only hope!

20953.original: Few can claim to have endured the might of my will.

20954.original: Your coming was foretold, servant of Ivalice. Or perhaps you serve another.

20955.original: I am Count Cidolfus Orlandeau. Your journey ends here.

20956.original: The clouds have parted and the skies cleared. It is time I bade you farewell.

20957.original: To the current of life we succumb, its judgment swift and final. Its bite as cold as steel.

20958.original: The hearts of men are black with corruption and must needs be cleansed!

20964.original: Even the strongest of shields cannot defend the weakest of wills. A moment's hesitation beckons a lifetime of pain!

20965.original: Misfortune hangs heavy on a head once held high. Such is poor cover for when the heavens fall.

20966.original: Honed is the blade that severs the villain's head. Endless is the path that leads him from hell.

20967.original: Hark! The screams of ruin rise above the storm's discord. Shudder not in her endless cold.

20968.original: You will need to withstand far more than this if you are to stand against the likes of <hex:021A020203>her<hex:021A020103>!

20969.original: I have been called the god of thunder. You will now know why! Upon my holy blade the very world lies in balance.

20970.original: And now the scales will tip!

20971.original: That was merely the beginning, Warrior of Light! Merely the beginning!

20974.original: You show promise. But promise won't save you from what comes next!

20975.original: Let this be your final testament!

20981.original: Tell me... What is your darkest fear?

20985.original: The path ends here, but for that arcane circle. Do you believe it some sort of gate?

20986.original: The ruins of the monastery lie ahead, but do not think the path will be easy.

20987.original: Harpies? My sisters would not allow this... Unless...

20988.original: Impressive. Perhaps you are deserving of your accolades. But do you have an answer for this...this Mist? Or is it aether?

20989.original: Only the name of these ruins lives on with my people. We have no knowledge of their past, nor do we wish it. Trespass into the monastery is avoided except when necessary.

20991.original: The last time I was here, the only thing holding watch over these stones was a deafening silence. Could it be that guardian rose from its slumber upon sensing your master's auracite?

20992.original: When the Empire marched upon Rabanastre, many who lived in the desert fled east to the sanctuary of the jungle. Some who were not turned away by my sisters are said to have taken refuge here.

20993.original: There! Another...Lucavi? It appears to be a knight, but how─

20994.original: She was a knight most noble, and her sacrifice will not be forgotten. My sisters will want to know much of her tale, I believe.

20995.original: Something here feels different than the monastery above... Otherworldly...

20996.original: Can you not feel it? An evil lurks here...one far beyond our ken.

20997.original: Once, when I was very young, I heard the elders speak of a dark city where the horrors that haunt our nightmares dwell. The Necrohol, they called it─the Necrohol of Mullonde.

20998.original: This...guardian─he is not like the first two. We must tread with care, lest our journey meet a premature end.

20999.original: The Mist I sensed before─the aether─its flow is much stronger now. It is almost as if the guardians we defeated were somehow preventing its escape...

21000.original: If I must forsake myself to keep mine oath, then so be it!
