24819.original: At long last, we are reunited...

24820.original: And we shall never be parted again!

24823.original: And I'll be damned if I let it end here!

24829.original: I want to see what tomorrow will bring!

24831.original: By my hand, this world shall be purified!

24832.original: The Darkness in your hearts shall be your undoing!

24833.original: May all be enveloped in Light!

24834.original: The age of peace and tranquility has come...

24900.original: We'll soon be off to our next destination! Raise your rods and make ready to set sail!

24902.original: All right, home port is callin'! Pack up your rods and prepare to return to Limsa!

24903.original: That's all the fishin' we'll be doin' today. Now's the time to measure your catch!

24904.original: Looks like <hex:020A03E80203> fished up Lady Luck herself! Here comes a spectral current!

24905.original: We've got <hex:020A03E80203> to thank for this spectral current! No one's going home hungry tonight!

24906.original: A fish ain't all <hex:020A03E80203> pulled out of the water! Here comes a spectral current!

24907.original: We're droppin' anchors here─Galadion Bay! Take your fill of the ocean's bounty!

24908.original: Time to settle in at Galadion Bay! The weather's lookin' a mite tetchy, but manage not to fall overboard and you'll have your pick of the ocean's creatures!

24909.original: Here it is─the southern Strait of Merlthor! Show me which of you is a fisher among fishers!

24910.original: Ain't it a sight? The southern Strait of Merlthor! Even in this hellish weather, I reckon you lot can haul a veritable feast onto the decks of this ship!

24911.original: Feel the cool wind of the northern Strait of Merlthor against your faces! The only thing better is the pull of a fish at the end of your hook!

24912.original: It's rough seas today in the northern Strait of Merlthor! Brave through them, however, and there's no tellin' what you'll pull outta the sea!

24913.original: The Rhotano Sea welcomes us with open arms─let's hope its fish are just as welcoming!

24914.original: Seems nature doesn't feel like welcoming us to the Rhotano Sea! No matter─we'll take what we need!

24915.original: Welcome to the Cieldalaes! Pick a spot at the rail and have at it─I want to see my deck squirmin' with scales!

24916.original: Not the best weather to be navigatin' the Cieldalaes, but the bigger the risk, the bigger the fish, I always say!

24917.original: Ah, taste the spray from the Bloodbrine Sea! This water's saltier than my old granddad and teemin' with fish for the takin'!

24918.original: The Bloodbrine's downright murderous today! Have a care when you haul in your catch, or the crimson in the swells might well be yours!

24919.original: Ohhh, we're sailin' round in Rothlyt Sound, with rod in hand and hearts unbound!♪<hex:02100103>Right, enough singin'─time for fishin'!

24920.original: Ohhh, the seas are wroth in Rothlyt Sound─hold fast now, mates, or we'll be drowned!♪<hex:02100103>Perfect conditions for hookin' a monster, I reckon!

24921.original: Look at all them squawkers! They must've spotted a shoal of tasty fish!

24922.original: Here they come! A whole flock of gulls flyin' in our direction!

24923.original: Seems the ship's got some feathered friends.<hex:02100103>I wonder if more of their mates'll be joinin' them...

24924.original: Keep an eye out. If the seagulls gather in a big ol' flock, it's a good idea to get your hook in the water.

24925.original: We've got dolphins fore and aft! That's a sign of good fortune, that is!

24926.original: Oho! Looks like a mob of dolphins is makin' right for us!

24927.original: See them dolphins swimmin' nearby?<hex:02100103>Could be they're scoutin' ahead for the rest of the pod.

24928.original: We could be in for some luck. Dolphins are harbingers of the spectral current─every sailor knows that!

24929.original: Look at all them squawkers! They must've spotted a shoal of tasty morsels!

24930.original: There's a whole flock of gulls here! The water must be churnin' with big ol' fish!

24931.original: Have you ever seen so many gulls!? Cast a line, and let's see what they're after!

24932.original: We've got dolphins fore and aft! That's a sign of good fortune, that is!

24933.original: Look! Dolphins! The Navigator smiles upon us this day!

24934.original: Dolphins! A whole mess of 'em! We're in for a wave of Llymlaen's favor─you'll see!

24935.original: There are gulls about...<hex:02100103>Makes you wonder what drew 'em near, eh?

24936.original: Keep an eye out. If the seagulls are flockin', it's a good idea to get your hook in the water.

24937.original: Seems the ship's got some feathered friends.<hex:02100103>I wonder if more of their mates'll be joinin' them...

24938.original: See them dolphins swimmin' nearby?<hex:02100103>Could be they're scoutin' ahead for the rest of the pod.

24939.original: We could be in for some luck. Dolphins are harbingers of the spectral current─every sailor knows that!

24940.original: We've spotted dolphins around the ship. Our luck's about to pick up, I reckon.

24941.original: Ah, you hear that whistlin' in the breeze? That means we're in the Sirensong Sea, and its bounty is yours for the takin'!

24942.original: Every siren in the sea is wailin' now! Will you go home with a barrel full o' fish, or will another soul be taken by their stormy song?

24943.original: Feast your eyes on Kugane, more dazzlin' than the Ruby Sea herself! The fish in these parts grow fatter than a merchant's coinpurse, so have your best bait at the ready!

24944.original: Kugane's no less a sight to behold, even under inhospitable skies! Keep one hand tight on your rod and the other firm on the bulwark!

24945.original: Behold the glitterin' expanse of the Ruby Sea! Each fish a jewel worthy of adornin' the end of your line!

24946.original: Looks like rough waters in the Ruby Sea! But if a tumbled jewel comes out prettier, then a tumbled fish... Well, I reckon we'll find out soon enough!

24947.original: Here were are─the One River! You'll have your pick of the meatiest fish in Othard, assumin' you have what it takes to wrest them from the waters!

24948.original: Seems the weather in the One River is less than welcomin'! But you wouldn't be here if you didn't have a steady hand and a sharp eye, so I know you'll pluck a prize from these troubled waters!

24949.original: That there in the horizon is the unnamed island! With waters this rich in marine life, we'll be headin' home with a healthy haul, Navigator willin'!

24950.original: We've some foul weather 'round the unnamed isle, but below these turbulent tides swim schools of fish most folk have never laid eyes on. Don't get discouraged─get castin'!

24951.original: Here we are! The Thavnairian cliffs are a feast for the eyes, aye, but there's a cast of colorful wavekin awaitin' your best bait down below! Stay sharp, anglers!

24952.original: Don't let these rough waters fool you. No matter how grey the skies, the azure seas of Thavnair are brimmin' with opportunities, so you'd best not flounder around!

25000.original: Arrive in the Mount Argai Mines

25006.original: Hah! When I saw that airship come down, I had my suspicions, but it <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> you!

25007.original: Hmph, when will you learn to call your lovely branch when you're in trouble? We'll discuss this later, but for now...onward!

25008.original: This way, my brave sapling! This way!

25009.original: Come, my lovelies! Come and join the fun!

25010.original: Continue on, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! We will keep these ones busy!

25011.original: A pinch of pixie magic, and─presto─a secret passage to Lakeland!

25013.original: A good old-fashioned dwarven decking, made mightier in exile!

25014.original: Come, servants of Darkness! I'll bathe in your vile blood!

25015.original: Darkness must die! Die, die, DIEEEEEE!

25016.original: Ahhhhhh, my blood! It burns in my veins!

25017.original: I'll rend your flesh and crush your bones!

25018.original: Like a gust of wind, I shall sweep away the pall of Darkness!

25020.original: Fast as the Light that banishes the Dark!

25021.original: I shall fight. For the world...and for you, my heart!

25023.original: Arise, my servants, and come to my aid!

25025.original: Very well, you may rest...but not in peace!

25026.original: Hehe, such lovely blossoms of blood!

25027.original: More! I need more to attend me! If you cannot stand, then crawl!

25028.original: Come now, death isn't so terrible. Not when you have company, hehehe...

25029.original: I would behold your beautiful blossoms! Let them bloom!

25030.original: Tainted though I am, I am still a Warrior of Light!

25031.original: Plunge into the depths of oblivion!

25032.original: These grounds will be strewn with your flesh!

25033.original: Why? Why can I not reach you? Is it because...I am tainted?

25034.original: Oho, we meet again, and during such a festive occasion besides! Let us revel, my friends!

25035.original: Come, come! Gather ye around, and lend an ear to my sweet melody!

25036.original: You're saving some of the action for us, I trust!

25037.original: Watch me, Milinda! This time I fight not to avenge, but to protect!

25038.original: Compared to the Virtues, this is just a relaxing diversion!

25039.original: Can't afford to botch this up─Miss Olvara would never let me live it down!

25040.original: Not ashamed to admit the offer of drinks has me fired up!

25041.original: Let's finish this quick and have those drinks! It's free, so Taynor can't complain!

25042.original: Have a taste of dwarven tradition, you airy glowing bastards!

25106.original: The Amalj'aa are in trouble.<hex:02100103>Let's split up.

25107.original: Very well. I shall fly to their aid.

25108.original: My poor child...<hex:02100103>I shall free thee from thy pain.

25109.original: Hmph. There's no end to them.

25110.original: I will call unto my children.

25111.original: The eikon waiteth in the heavens!<hex:02100103>My child shall bear thee to him!

25120.original: We must hold our ground until their defenses are broken!

25123.original: Once the way is clear, strike at the enemy's heart!

25124.original: Our flames will clear the way!<hex:02100103>Prepare to strike again!

25128.original: You would lend us your aid?<hex:02100103>Then let us crush this accursed war machine.

25129.original: You fight well!<hex:02100103>Our brethren will hear of your brave deeds.

25202.original: Destroy the target while evading its attacks

25203.original: Destroy the target while defending against its attacks

25204.original: Let's begin the G-Warrior training simulation. I've prepared three trials to teach you the basics.

25205.original: First, I want you to try attacking the guidance system. Don't worry, it won't fight back!

25206.original: The G-Warrior is armed with a range of weaponry. Now's your chance to learn what it's capable of.

25207.original: So far, so good. Let's move on to something a bit more advanced, shall we?

25208.original: If you feel you've already learned enough, you can end the simulation by accessing the training node.

25209.original: But once you begin combat, you won't be able to leave the simulation until it's over.

25211.original: The G-Warrior also comes equipped with the Pyretic Booster, which diverts even more power to its weapons and increases its speed and maneuverability.

25212.original: This, however, comes at a price. Activating it places a huge strain on the G-Warrior, so it must only be used in short bursts.

25213.original: That's why it's best to practice here before heading into battle.<hex:02100103>Now, try activating the Pyretic Booster!

25214.original: You'll notice that your movement speed is much improved. But as shown on your monitor, the G-Warrior becomes more and more structurally unstable as time passes.

25215.original: To deactivate the Pyretic Booster, press the same button again.

25216.original: Now to try using the Pyretic Booster to destroy the target.

25217.original: This time, the node will launch wide reaching attacks in quick succession. But with your increased movement speed, you should have no trouble evading them.

25218.original: Excellent work, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! You'd best deactivate the Pyretic Booster while I explain the final trial.

25219.original: Are you listening? Quickly, deactivate the Pyretic Booster!<hex:02100103>Even though it's only a simulation, it'll terminate prematurely if you're not careful.

25220.original: We've covered offense, now to look at defense. This is where the Aetherial Aegis should come in handy.

25221.original: Unfortunately, you can't keep the barrier up indefinitely as it will drain the G-Warrior's power reserves. You might even run out of energy for the weapons, so watch out.

25222.original: First, let's try deploying the Aetherial Aegis.

25223.original: The monitor shows how much power is being drained. Don't let it get too low!

25224.original: That's enough for now. Turn off the barrier using the same button used to deploy it.

25225.original: For the last trial, we'll use the Aetherial Aegis while attempting to destroy the target.

25226.original: Unlike before, there is no way to escape its attacks, so you'll need to weather them using the barrier.

25227.original: You're a natural! All right, that's everything. Time to end the simulation.

25228.original: You'll need to deactivate the Aetherial Aegis before you run out of power!

25229.original: That's as much damage as the G-Warrior can take. If this was a real combat situation, you'd be...well, let's not dwell on that.

25230.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? We can't test the Pyretic Booster if you don't activate it.

25231.original: Having trouble finding the button for the Aetherial Aegis? It should be clearly marked...

25232.original: Auto Restoration can mitigate a certain amount of damage incurred, but don't rely on it to carry you through the battle!

25233.original: Deploy the Aetherial Aegis to weather the storm!

25301.original: Well, well. It seems the savages have been busy...<hex:02100103>I shall enjoy breaking their new toy.

25302.original: My likeness reborn in ceruleum flames!

25303.original: Let us see what you make of this!

25304.original: Your wild flailing shall avail you naught!

25305.original: I tire of these games. Now to send you to a watery grave!

25306.original: It must have absorbed an aquatic eikon.<hex:02100103>Be sure to use the Pyretic Booster and Aetherial Aegis!

25308.original: It's preparing to strike!<hex:02100103>Quickly, deploy the Aegis!

25309.original: Activate the Pyretic Booster and keep moving!

25310.original: Destroy the ceruleum servants, then focus your attacks on the Sapphire Weapon!<hex:02100103>You mustn't let it launch its next attack!

25311.original: It's submerged, but not for long.<hex:02100103>Watch for signs of movement!

25313.original: The ceruleum servants are protecting the Weapon.<hex:02100103>Ignore the turrets for now and destroy the servants!

25314.original: The turrets can wait─ You must eliminate the ceruleum servants first!<hex:02100103>It's the only way!

25315.original: The turrets are preparing to self-destruct.<hex:02100103>Destroy them with the Ultima Buster!

25401.original: This battle shall be our last.

25408.original: Mankind's first hero...and his final hope!

25409.original: For victory, I render up my all!

25414.original: Clad in prayer, I am invincible!

25415.original: Your demise will be our salvation!

25419.original: Justice belongs to the victor, and the victor I shall be!

25421.original: Find your way out...if you can.

25423.original: Your end is nigh! Mine is the hope, mine is the Light!

25427.original: Why!? Why do you interfere!? Is this not meant to be our shared dream!?

25428.original: No, I cannot have erred... Ever have I walked this path, and I shall walk it to its end!

25429.original: And so it ends. In unceremonious silence.

25430.original: You would do well to hurry, lest you be set adrift in the rift.

25431.original: You are determined, that much I will allow. Mayhap you will yet win free.

25433.original: Hmph, did you truly think I would let you leave? Fool. This place shall be your grave.

25434.original: Here where we Ascians have been forced to retreat time and again, you will meet your demise.

25435.original: You clutch the crystal of Azem to your breast and wish upon it with all your heart.

25436.original: Hmph... Even with all this power, it seems I am hard-pressed to lay you low.

25437.original: No matter. If you will not fall, then you will be banished instead!

25438.original: Struggle all you like. Even should you break free, there is no way back.

25439.original: In this place you will drift forevermore. Farewell, hero.

25506.original: This is my fight. Don't follow me!

25507.original: Wait! Let us try your flight machine!

25508.original: Multiple hostile lifeforms confirmed. Activating the aegis unit. You go no further!

25509.original: Pulverized! Now that's what we like to see!

25510.original: Look at them all! I bet if we took one, they wouldn't even miss it...

25511.original: Intruders' presence confirmed. Activate superior flight units and fire at will!

25512.original: I enjoy explosions less when they're directed at us...

25514.original: I've never been more glad to have your help!

25516.original: Targets successfully confirmed. Equipment F23 is authorized for 724P, 767P, and 772P units.

25517.original: Attention 767P and 772P: please begin synchronous assault.

25519.original: Enemy units must be dispa-a-a─ Cut...enemy...

25520.original: Kill...ene─ You killed 767P and 772P! <hex:021A020203>I'll kill you<hex:021A020103>!

25522.original: So the advance units are dead... We will not tolerate this interference.

25523.original: Installing Operator 21O self-consciousness data and overriding core systems!

25524.original: This is...Operator...21O.<hex:02100103>Overriding...defe-fe-fense sysテム... Artillery ユニット...modification complete.<hex:02100103>敵 detected. Recommenda-a-a-tion...destroy...please...

25525.original: Defense systems active. Commencing elimination of intruders!

25526.original: Engaging overhead drones. Relevant combat protocol: anti-personnel lasers.

25527.original: Preparing to fire beam cannon. Condensing energy...

25528.original: Preparing to fire collider cannon. Initializing centrifuge...

25530.original: Initializing program: Life's Last Song. Prepare to regret your choices.

25531.original: Requesting air support. All nearby units, target the intruders.

25532.original: Requesting air support. Fire missiles at will.

25533.original: Damage to unit compromising FFCS, NFCS, and overall functionality. Message to Command: destroy...hostile lifeforms...

25535.original: Security systems online. Culling hostile lifeforms with laser turret.

25536.original: Culling hostile lifeforms with laser turret.

25543.original: Unusually high threat level confirmed. Converting to emergency protocols.

25544.original: Artillery system activated. Culling hostile lifeforms.

25545.original: 905S, this is Operator 21O. I'm going to force-start the enhancement program.

25555.original: We...<hex:02100103>                          will crush you<hex:02100103>         ...again and again

25559.original: Target delineation complete. All units, verify targets before engaging.

25560.original: Allied units unresponsive. However, retreat is not an option. Kill...or...die...

25561.original: Die... Die... They're all dead! You should all be dead!

25562.original: Killing... Is it “fun” for you too?

25563.original: Fun...funny, if that's the way of the world...

25602.original: Joined as one, never to be parted...

25603.original: Unbound by past or future in this single perfect moment!

25604.original: We shall draw your memories from you...

25605.original: And they will be your undoing!

25606.original: Now, your memories belong to us!

25612.original: You are unworthy of our utopia!

25617.original: Our utopia will only be complete...

25618.original: ...once you are erased from our memory!

25619.original: You've got to protect her memories! Hurry!

25622.original: See? Let's have another one. Half each?

25623.original: Hmm? What happened to the other half?

25624.original: Am I being erased from her memory!?

25625.original: I told you it would make a great necklace.

25626.original: Ohhh...it's beautiful! I think it'll really suit you!

25627.original: Me? But I thought you should have it...

25628.original: Is this ice? Where did this come from?

25629.original: If this goes on much longer, she'll forget everything!

25632.original: Now <hex:021A020203>this<hex:021A020103> one on the other hand...

25633.original: What am I doing with this? I'd never wear this color...

25634.original: No...! We can't let this happen!

25636.original: Tranquility and vitality in perfect balance...

25641.original: The fusion is undone... But is she all right?

25643.original: Yes... I remember. I am Gaia.

25644.original: Mine was the seat of Loghrif...

25645.original: I shall restore the power of Darkness to this star.

25646.original: I shall fulfill my duty as the Oracle of Darkness!

25647.original: By the will of the ancients!

25661.original: Infinite possibilities...condensed into a single moment!

25662.original: Pain shall be fleeting, joy everlasting...

25663.original: As I wish it, so shall the river of time flow!

25664.original: Your presence only deepens my solitude!

25665.original: I will erase you and know unending bliss!

25666.original: My memories will never be taken from me again...

25668.original: Even if my memory should fade...I will live on!

25702.original: Forward, hero. We shall see how strong you have become.

25703.original: Rest assured there are no tricks. You need but defeat the enemies before you.

25704.original: First, something easy. Those whom a budding hero might encounter at the beginning of <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> tale.

25705.original: And I believe I have the perfect subjects.

25706.original: Let not their appearance stay your hand. Beneath the facade, they are merely monsters.

25707.original: But come, we shouldn't dwell on the beginning when so much of your story awaits.

25708.original: Every tale requires villains. Defeat them, and claim your place as a hero.

25709.original: Well done, champion of Eorzea. Well done. Onward, then, over the bloodied bodies of the fallen.

25710.original: You tasted many sweet triumphs, yes. But so too did you taste bitter tragedy.

25711.original: Who could forget the Crystal Braves? That idealistic, pathetic dream born from a malformed creature.

25712.original: Faces you know and loathe, all. Let your hatred burn, and strike them down with all your might.

25713.original: With such ease yet again. You did always grow stronger with every battle.

25714.original: But enough talk. It is not your assertions that I wish to know, but your strength.

25715.original: Falsely accused of regicide, you fled for the snow-swept fields of Coerthas.

25716.original: Had you and the Scions met your demise that day in the sultanate, Lahabrea might have been spared his.

25717.original: But not only did you stubbornly live; you hurled yourself into the thick of the Dragonsong War.

25718.original: Swept along by the tide of events, you pursued and slew those who sought to stop the unending conflict. Just as you were bid.

25719.original: ...Or was it a thirst for vengeance that drove you?

25720.original: I trust you are beginning to limber up. Do keep up the fine form.

25721.original: Around heroes, people are wont to flock. People who harbor all manner of motives, each baser than the last.

25722.original: Come, let the curtains rise on the grand melee.

25723.original: No more than they deserve. In the end, their hand of friendship was tainted with personal desire.

25724.original: You know what comes next: you put an end to the Dragonsong War.

25725.original: There is no saving your comrade this time. All you can do is cut off the serpent's head.

25726.original: And as simple as that, a thousand-year war is brought to its conclusion.

25727.original: But every end marks a new beginning. And for heroes such as you, there is only ever conflict.

25728.original: Emperor Solus had kindled an insatiable flame. Garlemald was its name, and it raged across the land, consuming all in its path.

25729.original: Following the trail of ash, you set forth for Ala Mhigo and Doma, into a storm of blood.

25730.original: Again you fought, and again you grew stronger. So strong that we could no longer control you.

25731.original: Yours is an unnatural, beastly strength. And we shall lay it bare.

25732.original: In order to gain a foothold in the liberation effort, you journeyed to Far Eastern plains.

25733.original: There you encountered the land's greatest warriors, and sought to win them over to your cause.

25734.original: The strong are drawn to the strong. Thus did you gather new allies to your banner.

25735.original: Yet where ardent souls gather, so too do fires burn. In this way did you consign those around you to the flames.

25736.original: Burn them all, hero. Reduce them to nothingness, like the ephemeral morning dew they are.

25737.original: You did not hesitate...or perhaps could not? No matter. Let us turn our attention to the finale.

25738.original: Here we shall have a test between fellow beasts. It is only fitting, would you not agree?

25739.original: When I fought you in this flesh, 'twas I who triumphed. Will you turn the tables this time?

25742.original: I may not be the real Ardbert, but you'd do well not to underestimate me.

25743.original: All that made him the warrior he was─every battle waged, every blow swung─is part of my very being.

25744.original: So come! Fight me like you mean to take my head!

25745.original: Good, good... I sense your murderous intent.

25746.original: Aye, you'd kill me given the chance. Mayhap you think to recover this body?

25747.original: If so, prove that it's no use to me! Prove that I can't best you with it!

25748.original: Come! Come at me with everything you've got!

25749.original: <pant> I see... You're a different beast from when you faced my creations...

25750.original: Very well, I will transcend my very limits. And we'll see what you're truly capable of!

25751.original: Hold nothing back! For neither will I!

25800.original: Rex! There is no need for us to fight!<hex:02100103>Let us help you!

25801.original: Is he planning to bring down the whole castrum!?

25802.original: I know that formation...<hex:02100103>It was used in Werlyt all those years ago.

25803.original: So it's come to this...<hex:02100103>But no matter what, I can't afford to lose!

25804.original: Not even you can beat the Empire's finest!<hex:02100103>Activating Oversoul!

25805.original: Baelsar combat data ready.<hex:02100103>Initiating organic core overwrite.

25807.original: BEAR WITNESS TO THE GLORY OF THE EMPIRE!

25808.original: This is Werlyt, at the time of the invasion...<hex:02100103>Could the synthetic auracite be causing this!?

25817.original: Your skills are impressive, but they will not be enough.

25819.original: What is the meaning of this?<hex:02100103>Wait...that glow...

25820.original: I'm sorry, Father. We've come too far to back down now!

25822.original: With the power of the Emerald Weapon, we'll build a brighter tomorrow.<hex:02100103>Farewell!

25906.original: First things first: we need to harvest some clay.

25908.original: Next, we need to get the water flowing again.

25909.original: Last but not least, we need to fire up the kiln.

25910.original: All right, it's time to bake ourselves a porxie!

25911.original: The clay can be had at the Clayclot Cauldron, ribbit. Through this portal, if you would.

25912.original: Please follow me, ribbit, and put down any pests that bar the way.

25913.original: Allow me to assist you with the gap, ribbit.

25914.original: I did not imagine the place would be so infested, ribbit...

25915.original: The clay is just across the way...but you'll need to deal with the mudman first, ribbit.

26844.original: This one is not to be taken lightly. Be on your guard.

28005.original: ...tolling the death knell of all creation!

28008.original: ...all in existence bent to my will!

28011.original: From broken skies fall tears of flame...

28014.original: I have no need for restraint!

28016.original: Now comes the end for you and all you hold dear.

28019.original: How I've waited for this day!

28021.original: At last, I am become Zodiark!

29012.original: The Light doth obey my command!

30005.original: A sorrow so deep only emptiness remains.

30020.original: What we saw... What I saw...

30532.original: Go! I shall deal with these whelps!
