30535.original: Wails of lamentation call forth chaotic energies!

30536.original: The altered reality plunges into chaos!

30606.original: Intruder alert! Intruder alert! Initiating extermination protocol.

30608.original: Warning: you have entered the killing zone. Please stand by for bomb detonation, and remember─safety first!

30609.original: I have been authorized to eliminate all visitors with <hex:021A020203>extreme<hex:021A020103> prejudice. Apologies for the inconvenience.

30610.original: Welcome to Smileton, intruders! Please enjoy your stay─it will be <hex:021A020203>very<hex:021A020103> brief.

30611.original: Scan complete. Prepare for replicant synthesis.

30706.original: You're inside, then? Excellent! I will do all in my power to assist you in thwarting the Gruff clan's vile scheme!

30707.original: Be sure to make use of the fiendish lantern I gave you should you encounter any voidsent!

30708.original: Also, if you come across any lost souls, give them a good splash of holy water to guide them back to the mortal realm.

30709.original: These fiends hunger for more souls. Keep your nerves calm and your wits about you!

30710.original: Yay! A new friend to play with!

30711.original: Welcome to my banquet, friends. Pray join me in the dining room so I can─rather, so we <hex:021A020203>all<hex:021A020103> can feast.

30712.original: How dare you ruin our banquet!? You shall pay for this with your life─no, with your very soul!

30714.original: You think you can get away with stealing all my precious souls!? Never!

30715.original: Oh, how hard I labored to claim those souls! You will rue the day you dared defy the House of Gruff!

30716.original: Bah! Freeing a handful of souls will not affect my scheme. Before long, the Night of Devilry will be upon us!

30717.original: An unexpected guest, I see. But it matters not─no meddler will stop my plan!

30718.original: Oh, a new friend! Let's play together here─forever and ever and ever and ever and...

30719.original: Open as many pumpkin chests as you can to win! Watch out for the ones that go boom, though! Hahaha, this'll be fun!

30720.original: Wow, you're good at this game! Promise you'll play with me again, okay?

30722.original: Greetings, my dear friend. Pray eat your fill. We want your soul to be nice and plump when we devour it...

30723.original: Dinner is served! Dig in, everyone!

30724.original: You like it, then? Wonderful! Your soul is going to be oh-so-tasty now...

30726.original: Meddling wretch! You'll not leave this place alive!

30727.original: No doubt this is a ritual meant to usher in the Night of Devilry. You must save as many souls as you can and put a stop to it!

30728.original: You're more trouble than I thought you'd be. Fine, then! I shall harvest the souls I require myself!

30729.original: Is that all you've got? Come, now─at least make an effort!

30730.original: That's what I'm talking about. But now it's my turn!

30731.original: Why, you're the best friend I've ever had! What frightful fun this is!

30732.original: Why, it seems the lantern is having the desired effect. Splendid! Perhaps you'll be safe, after all.

30734.original: I just want to go home...

30735.original: Ruined! The ritual is ruined! You'll pay for your insolence...

30737.original: I fear we've no choice but for you to go along with this dreadful game for now...

30738.original: Strangely enough, the food appears to be entirely safe. I suggest you eat your fair share and try to keep Mama Gruff in a good mood.

30739.original: Splendid work! You've already saved an impressive number of souls. Keep going, and he'll have no choice but to abandon the ritual!

30806.original: Those who lived and festered, those who died and decayed...

30807.original: Its people sought ever greater freedoms no matter the cost...

30808.original: So they created the kindest, most gentle of beasts.

30809.original: Its steps were light, and its gift was as painless as it was beautiful.

30810.original: Bathed in its golden glow, they all slept happily ever after...

30811.original: For altruism and selfishness both were its carriers.

30812.original: Once upon a time, there was a beautiful blue star...

30813.original: ...that fell to pestilence, and rotted inside and out.

30814.original: The more its people clung to life, the more they suffered.

30815.original: Until they cursed not the illness, but their fellow corrupted.

30816.original: And the very last of them wished they had never been born at all.

30817.original: In a faraway place, a brilliant star eradicated disease...

30818.original: ...before destroying the selfsame lives it had saved.

30819.original: They tried to buy peace with fire and steel...

30820.original: And when one asked, “What is the point?” there were none left to answer.

30821.original: Farther still existed a star without strife...

30822.original: ...where none remembered life's trials─or its joys.

30823.original: What its people had gained from ease, they lost to apathy.

30824.original: Resuming peace protocol. All life-forms must be eliminated to achieve peace in perpetuity.

30825.original: Deploying perpetual war machines. Please stand by for order to fire.

30826.original: Vital signs detected... Initiating extinction protocol in accordance with primary directive.

30828.original: クル、シイ…<hex:02100103>グルジイヨォォォ

30901.original: We'd do well to flee to higher ground, lest the creature drown us in its rage.

30903.original: Its head and body are at odds... Yet I doubt it signifies anything good.

30904.original: Its head comes off!? Have care!

31002.original: The archbishop no longer rules Ishgard! The people shape our nation's future now!

31004.original: By the Fury, this is Ser Charibert's magick! Have care!

31007.original: ●強力な攻撃が来ます！集まってください！

31008.original: The time is come...to call upon the true power...of the Heavens' Ward...

31009.original: This bodes ill... Quickly, take cover behind my shield!

31010.original: ●なんという攻撃だ……！<hex:02100103>だがっ、ここで倒れるわけにはいかない……！

31012.original: His Eminence... You will return...His Eminence to me...

31016.original: These fiends empower the blasphemy! We must strike them down first!

31017.original: Let us settle this...once and for all!

31018.original: In the name of Ishgard, we will free you from your torment!

31101.original: I'll draw his attention. <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, keep me in the fight!

31102.original: I can't die until I lay Charlet to rest!

31103.original: Lightning-aspected aether!? Keep away from it!

31104.original: What's that lightning doing to me!? Cast Esuna, quickly!

31110.original: As long as I hold out, he won't lay a finger on you!

31111.original: I-I can't do it! I'm too w-w-weak!

31112.original: No you're not, Charlet! Your kindness is your strength!

31114.original: This is our chance. Let's finish him off!

31115.original: It's over, Charlet. I'll end your suffering!

31116.original: Th-This is all wrong! All wrong!

31119.original: No... I can't let it end...like this...

31200.original: Hold nothing back! Push yourself to your limit, and me to mine!

31201.original: Hah! Still fight in you, I see.

31202.original: Is this truly the best Hydaelyn's chosen can muster?

31203.original: Soon you will know the full extent of my power.

31205.original: I know you feel it, too. The inferno swelling within you.

31206.original: Come! Let all creation be consumed by our ravenous fervor!

31207.original: Do not tell me your life's fire is already spent...

31208.original: Yes, yes! Rise once more! It mustn't end yet!

31209.original: No, not yet! Not until the last of me is spent!

31211.original: This is my moment! Our moment!

31212.original: Did you not wish to take my head?

31214.original: Have you no rage left for me? No rancor?

31301.original: The Elder Seedseer must not be disturbed! Protect her!

31302.original: He makes for the Elder Seedseer! To her side!

31303.original: The ceremony is almost complete. Keep Gleipnir at bay!

31305.original: Ugh... I can scarcely raise my spear... Has the poison taken effect already!?

31306.original: He calls upon his wicked minions! Bring them to me─they will fall before my spear!

31307.original: You must fend off his attacks if the Elder Seedseer is to survive!

31310.original: So long as we are within the barrier, we need not fear Gleipnir's poison!

31311.original: However, the battle is far from over. Steel yourselves!

31312.original: The forest's blessing shall guide us through the most torrential storm!

31313.original: More beasts! Protect the Elder Seedseer!

31314.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, to me! We must group together!

31315.original: Even Gleipnir lashes out in the face of death. Bring an end to its misery while the barrier still stands!

31316.original: Ea<hex:021F0103>Sura, I now fathom the depth of your suffering. For all that you held dear, I shall see to it that you are given peace.

31317.original: His rancor makes even the elementals shudder in fear. The barrier may not last for much longer.

31319.original: There is hope yet! I shall erect the hedge once more!

31320.original: The pain is too much to bear... I cannot...I cannot move...

31321.original: That mist bears Gleipnir's poison! Do not allow them to drift near the Elder Seedseer!

31322.original: 毒気が浄化されただけでなく、力が溢れてくる！<hex:02100103>これが精霊の力なのか！？！

31324.original: The ceremony is almost complete! Bear Gleipnir's wrath for just a while longer!

31326.original: I shall draw his ire. <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, lend the Elder Seedseer a portion of your power!

31327.original: Come, you pitiful beast! Let us see the contents of your innards!

31328.original: I swore that I would protect her. This time I shall not falter!

31329.original: <cough> ...Ugh... <wheeze> My next charge shall be my last... <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, gift your aether unto the Elder Seedseer!

31334.original: My aether is exhausted... I cannot stand...

31400.original: Aim for the weak point of the aetherial orb!

31402.original: Here it comes! We're counting on you, Lorens!

31403.original: Aye, no enemy's weakness escapes my eyes...

31405.original: See how easy that was? I reckon you can do it, too, Actin' Commander!

31406.original: Is that all you've got? Time to put ye out of yer misery!

31408.original: Wheiskaet, reporting for duty! Aye, now the real fun begins!

31409.original: Now we're gettin' somewhere! Let's finish the deed!

31410.original: Look alive, everyone! Victory is within our grasp!

31412.original: The blasphemy's absorbin' their aether! I have a bad feelin' about this...

31415.original: Pshhh! As do we! For the future of the Indigo Deep!

31416.original: That's enough aether to go blastin' this entire island! We'd better work fast!

31417.original: Where'd it go? Best be wary...

31418.original: That trick o' yours won't work on us anymore. Ain't that right, Actin' Commander?

31419.original: There is no end to them. Prepare yourselves!

31420.original: Landenel! U'odh! Now's yer time to shine!

31421.original: Wheiskaet! Defend us with yer blade!

31422.original: Absorbin' their aether, is it? We'd best finish those beasts quickly...

31423.original: The wall's gone! Aye, this is our chance to strike!

31425.original: Here it comes again. Steel yerselves!

31426.original: ●皆、諦めるな！　活路はきっとある！

31427.original: Noll...and the Crushing Tide! Let us stand as one, my friends!

31428.original: If we don't take out those orbs, this'll be over before it starts. Ye ready!?

31501.original: Coordinate with G'raha Tia and defeat the beasts!

31502.original: Coordinate with your comrades and defeat the beasts!

31503.original: I'll command the beasts' attention. See to the wounded!

31504.original: They're being overwhelmed by fear...<hex:02100103>Alphinaud, do what you can!

31507.original: Those who can stand, come with me!

31508.original: ...Worry not for the refugees, but for yourself, boy!

31509.original: I don't like the look of that...<hex:02100103>Stay sharp!

31511.original: You take the lead, I'll provide support!

31512.original: More beasts... I only hope my newfound abilities are enough!

31513.original: You're starting to get the hang of those things.

31514.original: They fight hard...but not hard enough!

31515.original: We've lost too many already. G'raha, with me!

31517.original: Is there no way to break the chain of transformations!?

31518.original: Watch out, Alisaie! This one is not like the rest!

31519.original: See if I care! I won't back down!

31522.original: The air crackles with energy... Find cover!

31524.original: Oho, a trio for the ages!

31525.original: I had a feeling I'd find you here.<hex:02170103>This should be the last of the worst troublemakers. With me!

31527.original: Jullus will see the refugees to safety. We must keep the beasts at bay!

31601.original: Set explosives on the magitek weaponry

31602.original: Find a place to hide, then relay your progress

31608.original: Head north and join the vanguard

31611.original: Two on the gate... Could get messy if I'm not careful.

31612.original: One guarding the controls. Time he took a nap!

31613.original: Now to set the explosives. Best keep quiet...for now.

31614.original: So, they've got guard dogs, eh? No use hiding, they'll soon sniff me out. Luckily, I've come prepared.

31616.original: That should do the trick. Now to hide and send word.

31617.original: This is Thancred. The explosives are in place.

31618.original: Very good. All is proceeding as planned.<hex:02170103>Head to the control terminal. It should be to the northwest.

31620.original: Understood. Have the others wait at the rendezvous point.

31624.original: A brief respite─but stay alert.<hex:02170103>Keep the carriages safe!

31626.original: What impeccable timing!<hex:02170103>Fear not, friends─the savior of Ishgard is here!

31628.original: A fine display, but the other carriages are still in danger.<hex:02170103>Go on ahead─we'll hold the line!

31630.original: We're the only ones still strugglin'?<hex:02170103>Time we put our backs into it, then!

31632.original: That big bastard's goin' straight for the carriages!<hex:02100103>Stop it in its tracks!

31636.original: You lot all right back there?

31638.original: Hear that?<hex:02170103>Get to the front and turn the tide!

31641.original: The supply caravan is safe for the time being, and Thancred's team have thrown the enemy into disarray.

31648.original: Keep the war machines at bay!

31649.original: Haha! More fodder for my flames!

31650.original: So many... At this rate, we will be overwhelmed!

31651.original: I will not fall so easily! These curs will taste my wrath!

31652.original: More of them! Quick, lend Sadu a hand!

31653.original: Make way! These whelps will rue the day they crossed my path!

31654.original: None shall escape my chains! Now is your chance to strike!

31655.original: Hahaha! May your screams fill the air!

31656.original: ●あの魔導リーパー……止めなきゃ危ない！

31658.original: 5 seconds until Sadu completes the ritual of Falling Dusk.

31659.original: 4 seconds until Sadu completes the ritual of Falling Dusk.

31660.original: 3 seconds until Sadu completes the ritual of Falling Dusk.

31661.original: 2 seconds until Sadu completes the ritual of Falling Dusk.

31662.original: 1 second until Sadu completes the ritual of Falling Dusk.

31663.original: It's time. We only have one shot at this, so let's make it count!

31700.original: If our assumption is correct, the fugitives have come─and may still be here. Keep your eyes peeled and your guard up.

31701.original: These halls are home to dangerous creatures. I will draw their attention, that you may focus on applying your techniques.

31702.original: To begin with, cast Kardia on me. The spell will establish a magical link between us.

31703.original: The residual aether of your attacks will be channeled unto me, healing my wounds as you deal damage to our foes.

31704.original: Sizable fiend ahead. I believe this calls for a barrier.

31705.original: This time, augment your spells using Eukrasia, then cast Eukrasian Diagnosis on me.

31706.original: This will bestow a barrier on me that provides both protection and healing.

31709.original: More of the same plant taken... What could it possibly be?

31710.original: Traces of ice... Someone recently fought here─a proficient wielder of magic.

31711.original: The fugitives may be close. Be on your guard.

31712.original: This will go poorly for you if you resist!

31714.original: This is getting us nowhere! We must subdue Loifa first!

31715.original: Oh, for the love of─ Have care, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

31716.original: Impressive! To see how well you wield your nouliths, one would not think you a novice!

31717.original: Hm, nothing of note here... Let us head deeper into the arboretum.

31719.original: Ancel, that's enough! You mustn't lose your temper!

31724.original: Hmph! There'll be nothing left of you but ash!

31733.original: Yes, just so! Let us continue on!

31734.original: Excellent! Now we may proceed with confidence!

31736.original: It's over! Lay down your arms, and I promise you won't come to further harm!

31737.original: Godsdammit... If it wasn't for that sage...

31739.original: So, shall we practice some somanoutical fundamentals?

31740.original: Some manner of plant seems to have been harvested here. I can't identify it by the remaining parts, however...

31741.original: There may be other clues nearby. We should investigate further.

31742.original: Th-Their enhancement has given them such power!?

31743.original: ロイファを狙いましょう！

31744.original: Mahaud, return the favor and take care of that sage! Finish it!

31802.original: Gibbet will hurt 'em from the flank, and Gallows will surprise 'em from behind. If you're getting' swarmed, use Guillotine to carve yourself some space.

31803.original: The chimera won't be able to resist the smell of blood─make sure to soak these sands in it!

31804.original: You're getting' the hang of it! Gibbet will hurt 'em from the side─switch off between that and Gallows to make your attacks even more deadly!

31805.original: That's what I like to see! Gallows will hurt 'em from behind─switch off between that and Gibbet to make your attacks even more deadly!

31806.original: You're usin' Guillotine like a true killer! Reap a feast of souls in one fell swoop!

31807.original: You've takin' to killin' more quickly than I could've hoped. It'll be an easy thing to summon your avatar to your side.

31808.original: Let's move on to the fun bit, eh? Your avatar will help you strike fear into the hearts of your foes.

31809.original: Now call it to your side! Blood stalk and grim swathe will make short work of these fiends!

31810.original: The bloodshed should've gotten the chimera's attention. Steel yourself for a fight!

31811.original: Our target arrives. Finish this and I'll let you keep its head as a trophy!

31812.original: So long as your avatar is by your side, monsters like this are nothin' more than easy prey.

31813.original: Show me you've been listenin', <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Give your avatar a feast to remember!

31814.original: Remember to position yourself! Gibbet from the side, Gallows from the rear! Simple enough, eh?

31815.original: Fill your Soul Gauge and summon your avatar!

31819.original: Harvest the souls of the fallen to summon your avatar!

31900.original: Hehehe! I have awaited this feast for far too long. I think I shall skip straight to the main course!

31901.original: The pig squirms and writhes. Stay still and let the chef's blade finish the job!

31902.original: Hmph. Very well. Meat is all the more delicious when it is tenderized!

31903.original: Give him a taste of his own vile medicine, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Rip his soul out!

31904.original: You just worry about Orcus, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I'll take care of the rest.

31907.original: Ugh... I can't die...without a final meal.

32000.original: Lightning gathers! We must head it off!

32001.original: To attack with such reckless abandon... Their bodies and minds must be on the verge of breaking!

32002.original: Sharlayan will suffer your villainy no more!

32003.original: Damn it, they're not in their right minds!

32004.original: You'll pay for all the lives you've destroyed!

32006.original: Stay with me, my friends! We'll free you yet!

32009.original: みんな、当たらないように散るんだ！

32013.original: Heh heh heh... Let us begin with you, Ancel!

32014.original: That will do, that will do... Mahaud─your turn!

32015.original: Man's frail flesh is his greatest flaw! If we are to evolve, we must break free of its confines!

32016.original: Hm, so this is your limit. <sigh> Yet another disappointment...but perhaps you can take one of these meddlers with you to the grave!

32018.original: You truly are fascinating specimens! Oh, the things I will learn from your cadavers!

32019.original: This proving ground was prepared especially for you. I trust you won't mind if I harvest a sample or two!

32020.original: Come, let us test the edge of my scalpel!

32021.original: I am quite experienced in the art of amputation. You won't feel a thing!

32025.original: This bodes ill... We must finish him quickly!

32026.original: Then we have no choice but to subdue them.

32027.original: People are not your playthings, you fiend!

32028.original: Hmph, laugh while you can! You won't be doing it much longer!

32029.original: It has been a tremendous pleasure, my dear subjects. But all good things must come to an end.

32031.original: Damn it, he's taken control of their minds again!

32032.original: Oho, it seems our two sages have protection─intrinsic and extrinsic, respectively. Curiouser and curiouser...

32033.original: Not good... At this rate, their minds will be irreparably damaged!

32034.original: This magick is derived from somanoutics! If we destroy his nouliths, we can break its hold!

32035.original: Too clever by half! But you'll need to be quick too, else your comrades' brains will melt in their skulls.

32036.original: Yes, we did it! Are you all right, my friends!?

32038.original: Your successor is proving <hex:020815E905FF0868657273656C66FF0868696D73656C6603> quite the nuisance, Hatia... But unique as <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> is, <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> is most definitely worth the trouble!

32039.original: Keep your comrades alive and break their mind control.

32101.original: I must save them... But first...

32103.original: I'll shatter you against the stones!

32104.original: Be assailed by ice and flame!

32105.original: Your bones to ash! Your flesh to ice!

32107.original: I cannot allow you to run free!

32109.original: No... The lives of my colleagues are at stake!

32110.original: Should it cost me my life, I will triumph!

32111.original: I must... I must return you to your cell!

32113.original: Cast off my chains, and I shall bind you again! Ever tighter...

32114.original: This shall be your final resting place!

32116.original: Run all you like, but my chains will catch you!

32117.original: Drag them unto the depths, O chains!

32118.original: I will lock you away, once and again! Forever!

32201.original: 理由はわからないが、獄卒長が環境を作り変えたみたいだ……！<hex:02100103>ともかく今は眼前の脅威を、フェネクスを弱らせてくれ！

32300.original: Minato holds me responsible for Kisei's death. I will keep its attention.

32301.original: Have care. The air is thick with her malice.

32302.original: It means to charge! <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, can you break its focus?

32304.original: Remain calm and alert. It may attempt another charge.

32305.original: A formidable foe indeed. But we will not be bested!

32306.original: It readies to strike! On your guard!

32308.original: We must discuss your change of vocation─<hex:021A020203>after<hex:021A020103> dealing with the blasphemy.

32312.original: It comes for me! Perhaps a grazing shot will break its concentration.

32314.original: I am not so easily broken.

32315.original: I sense something amiss. Quickly, to me!

32316.original: A test of my will and training both. Hold fast, everyone!

32317.original: Well done, Gosetsu. Now, I believe it is past time we put Minato's soul to rest.

32402.original: Impressive... I shall have to try something different.

32403.original: I see you won't be easily overcome...but neither will I.

32404.original: We've only just begun. Come at me with your all!

32411.original: Very well, let us move to the final trial.

32412.original: Break your chains, shed your burdens─and show me your strength of will!

32413.original: You still stand. The people of your time are more resilient than I had dared hope.

32501.original: I have awaited this moment... Witness the full measure of a hemitheos's power!

32502.original: There is but one master in Asphodelos!

32504.original: If you insist upon this folly, then you must face the full extent of my authority!

32505.original: I shall feast upon your aether!

32506.original: Your aether turns...and by it shall you be undone!

32507.original: A rat in a maze is amusing at first, but it is still a rat─vermin to be disposed of.

32508.original: Scurry, vermin, ere my blade finds your bellies...

32509.original: This chlamys is no mere affectation, I assure you!

32510.original: For trespass in my domain shall you be judged!

32511.original: Do not believe victory yours... I can yet shed this meager form and usher you back to the star!

32512.original: To him do I dedicate this transformation─this victory!

32513.original: Power courses through me! And you... You will feed my subjects!

32514.original: A tragedy unfolds within the halls of Asphodelos. Rejoice, for you are its star!

32515.original: And the final act begins! Bring your adoring fans to tears!

32516.original: To those who endured every tragic turn, stand at attention for the curtain call!

32517.original: A tragedy demands death. Discard your delusions of salvation and embrace catharsis!

32600.original: 'Tis said that there are no ifs in history, yet man is wont to dream. Let us dream, then, of a future where a dear comrade lived...

32601.original: Your feeble light shall fade before my brilliance!

32602.original: Undone by mortal will. Whither now...?

32604.original: O Ascalon! Drink deep of the power of slumbering gods!

32605.original: Y-You survived my divine reckoning!? Impossible!

32606.original: This is the power of Light? No... If I must fall, then so shall you!

32608.original: Thou hast survived my song...<hex:02100103>Curse thee and thine eye, Hraesvelgr!

32610.original: Wriggling maggots! I shall grind you to paste in my jaws!

32611.original: I swore to Shiva─swore that I would not take the lives of men... Stop me, I prithee!

32612.original: I thank thee, servant of Hydaelyn... Now I may go to be with my beloved...

32613.original: Thus did one song draw to a close. But here and now, this minstrel shall perform another─a song of imagination transcending...

32614.original: At long last, this flesh belongeth to me! And now, wicked mortals─my dirge shall usher you unto your doom!

32615.original: Hahahaha! By the power of mine enemy's eyes, I am become a god eternal!

32617.original: O Ascalon! Purge the tainted with the light of sorrow immeasurable!

32618.original: O Ascalon! Consign the wicked with the light of rancor unquenchable!

32619.original: O Ascalon! Scorch the earth with the light of regret unfathomable!

32620.original: Your time is come! Eyes of mine enemy, bring oblivion unto the unbelievers!

32623.original: In pursuit of the archbishop, the Warrior of Light journeyed to Azys Lla, where <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> confronted a primal born of the power of the Eye: King Thordan and his knights twelve.

32624.original: Though <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> emerged victorious, <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> comrade's body was claimed by Nidhogg, who brought his unbridled rage to bear against Ishgard.

32625.original: A single life can alter the course of history... Enslaved by an ancient relic, the great wyrm Hraesvelgr descended upon Ishgard at his vengeful brother's side.

32626.original: Thus did a dreadful new divinity arise─one endowed with the nigh-irrepressible life force of two great wyrms...

32627.original: Tell me, Warrior of Light. How do you propose to end this conflict?

32628.original: If you believe that eliminating me will undo a thousand years of strife and suffering, then you are a fool.

32700.original: It should go without saying, but stay on your guard. There was quite the menagerie of horrors when last I was here.

32702.original: Merlwyb and I shall hold them off. Press on, my friends!

32704.original: I shall hold the line here. When you see an opening, take it, and do not look back!

32705.original: Nerva never did make things easy. Let's get this over with.

32707.original: There is no end to them...

32708.original: Careful there, Leveilleur. They have their sights set on you.

32711.original: I will see to the rabble. You focus on the large one there.

32713.original: This ends here, Nerva. For Garlemald, her people, and all who call this star home!

32714.original: Blasphemy or no, I'll not suffer anyone who gets in my way!

32719.original: We will be overrun at this rate...

32720.original: Bring them here, and leave the rest to me.

32722.original: Dammit, how could that have missed!? No matter, we will deal with them easily enough.

32723.original: Behind me, quickly! I shall take the brunt of it!

32726.original: We've come too far...to give up now...

32727.original: Then let's put an end to this, shall we?

32730.original: Get a hold of yourself, <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03>! We've a monster to slay!

32731.original: Reach the top of the Tower of Babil!

32802.original: Arrive at the Threshold of Bounty

32806.original: Unrecognized aetherial signature...<hex:02100103>Brazen thief! You will proceed no further!

32807.original: Turn back, treasure seeker, or this vault will be your tomb.

32808.original: Your greed will prove your undoing...

32809.original: Warning. This vault is under my protection.<hex:02100103>Failure to withdraw will invite chastisement.

32811.original: Leave now, and live.<hex:02100103>This is your final warning.

32814.original: Glyph of passage detected.<hex:02100103>Confirming bearer's identity...

32900.original: I have taken the liberty of preparing an <hex:021A020203>electrifying<hex:021A020103> stage for you.

32901.original: Meet one of my creations. You might find it a <hex:021A020203>handful<hex:021A020103>.

32902.original: I will lay Garlond low, but first I must break you!

32903.original: <pant> I will not suffer...to be in another's shadow!

32904.original: Let us dance, champion of Eorzea.

32907.original: Come, we shall see if you can finish what you have started.

32909.original: That you should still stand... Very well, then!

32916.original: Right, I'll examine the equipment for intelligence. Press on─I'll let you know if I learn anything.

32917.original: Well, well, would you look at this! It's the armor we borrowed for our mission at Castrum Centri!

32918.original: If this isn't fate, I don't know what is! Go on, strap yourself in and raise hells!

32919.original: If you will not yield, then you will be destroyed!

32920.original: We need to make our way down. There ought to be a terminal for the lift up ahead.

32921.original: Here it is. If you'd care to take the van, I'll follow after I've had a look around.

33006.original: The Builder has been made to yield...

33007.original: Intriguing. Then the Destroyer shall take your measure...

33008.original: ...After you have provided my servant with some sport.

33009.original: In the name of the Destroyer, I will lay you low.

33010.original: My divine axe will rend you in twain!

33011.original: Come, show me the strength of mankind!

33012.original: Upon the ground you shall crawl!

33013.original: By my authority as the Destroyer...

33014.original: I will break you body and soul!

33018.original: Can you predict your own undoing?

33020.original: A domain aspected to lightning... Byregot is here, I shouldn't doubt.

33021.original: The mechanical spire ahead could have been plucked straight out of legend!

33022.original: That you should best a divinity... I couldn't have asked for better help!

33024.original: So the gods have minions at their beck and call... We must proceed with care.

33025.original: Rhalgr isn't known as the god of destruction without reason. Steel yourself.

33026.original: Ahead stands a statue I have fashioned for our contest.

33027.original: Come, mortals. Enter my realm─if you dare.

33029.original: Then the voice that called out to us...

33030.original: Mere minions are no match for you, 'twould seem.

33031.original: A divinity awaits us beyond. Have care.

33032.original: Look how the sky has changed! The result of your victory over Azeyma, I daresay...

33033.original: There's a city up ahead... Could there be people here?

33034.original: Prepare to be judged, children of man.

33038.original: The flames of the abyss consume all.

33040.original: From ashes you came, to ashes you will return.

33041.original: Still you defy our divine authority.

33042.original: Very well. Let us proceed to your judgment.

33043.original: We, the Traders, shall weigh your souls!

33044.original: Preserve the balance if you can.

33050.original: Once more─and once more only─we shall weigh your souls.

33052.original: The moment of judgment is come.

33054.original: You shall wander in purgatory for eternity.

33056.original: Well done! You are deserving of reward!

33057.original: Man's tenacity is a sight to behold!

33058.original: As a show of esteem, we shall bring our all to bear.

33060.original: So this is the spirit of man...

33061.original: You shall bear witness to our might...

33062.original: But will you be able to comprehend it?

33063.original: That mortals should set foot in our divine realm...<hex:02100103>Come, we shall see whether you are fit to remain!

33064.original: So, you are resolved to face me.

33065.original: By my power shall a new world be forged.

33069.original: Behold the virtuosity of the Builder!

33070.original: Behold the works of a god!

33073.original: The thunder is mine to command!

33074.original: If you would halt our ascension, then press on...

33075.original: Witness the glory of the divine!

33078.original: You will be scoured by the light of the Sun!

33079.original: O crimson fan, in fire woven...

33080.original: In your wake leave naught uncleansed!

33081.original: Is it just a mirage...or something more?

33082.original: Hahaha! I've quite warmed to you!

33085.original: Raging flames, dance upon the wind!

33088.original: A gift of flame for our children!

33100.original: Every soul in this domain ssserves me now.<hex:02170103>Come, feassst upon their flesh!

33102.original: The castle answers his call...<hex:02170103>We'd do well to break up this feast quickly.

33103.original: 戦闘が長引くとまずそうね……。

33104.original: Then let's see these guests on their way.

33105.original: Behold the power of the archfiend of earth!

33107.original: We are deathlessssss.<hex:02170103>You cannot defeat that which cannot die!

33108.original: ゆえに、貴様らに勝ち目はない！

33109.original: Struggle and slaughter all you like!

33110.original: Our foe has too great an advantage...

33111.original: We need to drag him out of this damnable feast.

33112.original: There's no end in sight...<hex:02170103>A retreat may be in order.

33113.original: 一度退いて、策を練った方がよさそうね。

33114.original: However incurred, a debt is a debt.<hex:02170103>I will repay it here and now.

33115.original: この戦いに加勢することで、チャラにしてもらうぞ。

33117.original: You will tremble before my true ssstrength!

33120.original: Finally getting serious, are we?<hex:02170103>Very well, let us return the favor!

33121.original: ならば、こっちも全力でいくぞ！

33124.original: We cannot win without Zero. We must help her!

33125.original: Hmph. If I must deal with <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> first...<hex:02170103>I'll kill you all myself!

33128.original: This place will be your grave!

33129.original: This magick... We must stop him <hex:021A020203>now<hex:021A020103>!

33132.original: She can turn voidsent into crystal...

33200.original: The Ultima Weapon has partaken of the power of eikons! None can stand against it!

33202.original: The wind is at my beck and call!

33203.original: Naught can pierce the raging tempest!

33204.original: Thy foe is Darkness clad in steel. If thou wouldst triumph, thou must look to the Light.

33205.original: Titan's essence...torn from the Ultima Weapon!?

33206.original: No matter─it still harbors the might of other eikons!

33208.original: The land itself is mine to wield!

33210.original: Once more, crystal bearer. Look to the Light to vanquish the Darkness.

33212.original: But the Ultima Weapon is not spent of eikon power yet!

33214.original: So this is the strength of the eikon-slayer...

33215.original: Very well, let us see how you fare when the Ultima Weapon's power inhibitor is disengaged!

33216.original: Naught will remain of you but ash!

33217.original: Yield not to the Darkness, my child. Pray to the Crystal with all thy being.

33218.original: No! How...how are you doing this!?

33219.original: We settle this once and for all!

33220.original: I need not the power of eikons to defeat you! Gaze upon <hex:021A020203>true<hex:021A020103> power!

33221.original: This is most...unexpected. You are possessed of great might, this I will allow.

33222.original: Yet yours is not the might of a ruler! Such is the difference between us─a difference that will assure my victory!

33224.original: How much destruction must be wreaked before you are sated!?

33225.original: I have not the strength...to shield thee again...

33226.original: Permit not the manifestation of that vile magick...lest Darkness prevail!

33234.original: Your time is at an end, Hydaelyn!

33400.original: I will suffer none to oppose Lord van Baelsar!

33401.original: Like countless other challengers, you will fall before me!

33403.original: Your defeat will bring Lord van Baelsar's noble conquest one step closer to fruition!

33404.original: Ugh... So this is the strength of <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> who vanquished Titan...

33405.original: Let us aid you, my lord!

33406.original: What? I thought I ordered you to leave!

33407.original: Forgive us, my lord, but we couldn't let you face the enemy alone!

33409.original: Your conviction and courage will not be for naught! This I swear!

33410.original: For victory and vengeance, I will strike you down!

33415.original: We shall go together, amidst a raging inferno!

33416.original: No amount of pain can loosen my grip!

33418.original: Rest in peace, men... I shall join you soon...

33419.original: <pant> <pant> It's over... Strong as you are, you cannot survive this!

33423.original: Flee, damn you! Flee while you still can!

33424.original: Let me show you a technique passed down in my homeland!

33425.original: You do not hold back! Very well, neither shall I!

33426.original: Ignore pain... Ignite rage... And fight with the fury of wildfire!

33427.original: You will have no mercy from me!

33429.original: We've raised the alarm as you bade...and now we would fight with you!

33506.original: This is Cid. To review, our goal is to deactivate the magitek field.

33507.original: If you could create a diversion─that's to say, wreak lots of havoc─I'll search for the field generator.

33508.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, how are you faring? ...Reached a dead end, you say? I believe I know where you are.

33509.original: There's a disposal chute nearby. Find it and jump in, and you'll emerge in a different sector.

33510.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, assault crafts are near! Watch out for incoming fire!

33511.original: I've located the controls for the security system. A moment while I disable the barriers.

33512.original: Another bulkhead, eh? Fortunately I'm equipped for the task. Stand back!

33513.original: Come on, the field generator should be just up ahead!

33514.original: There it is! Keep the enemy occupied while I take it out of commission!

33515.original: You will <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> take any more from me!

33516.original: The pain I have suffered, I shall visit upon you a hundredfold!

33518.original: Hmph, you're tough, I grant you that.

33519.original: But I will break you soon enough!

33520.original: You will not defeat me! <hex:021A020203>You will not<hex:021A020103>!

33521.original: I'm also pleased to say I've found a suit of armor. Press on─I'll meet you just ahead.

33522.original: Damn, reinforcements! Take care of them, would you?

33523.original: We must hold the enemy here! All units─attack!

33524.original: The central crossing is overrun! Requesting immediate reinforcements!

33525.original: Gah, damn these savages! Deploy the reserve colossi!

33526.original: How can this be...? R-Reinforcements! We need more reinforcements!

33601.original: The same end, again and again.

33602.original: All of us have known despair.

33603.original: A sorrow so deep only emptiness remains.

33605.original: As surely as stars fall from the heavens, all civilizations are destined to die.

33607.original: All light is destined to fade─all happiness give way to suffering.

33610.original: Your suffering is at an end.

33611.original: Ahhh, it comes flooding back. The memory of a star ravaged by disease.

33612.original: Quick as a shadow, doom comes to claim us.

33613.original: Ever shall we sing, our voice resounding throughout the vast expanse.

33614.original: Unto you we shall deliver the answer of all the lives that came before.

33615.original: No life, no star, nor the universe itself...

33700.original: For the sake of the star, I will deal with you personally!

33701.original: You have meddled enough! Farewell, servant of Light!

33702.original: Surrender not, my child. Look thee to the Light...

33703.original: And receive of the power to banish the Darkness!

33704.original: That You should still have the strength to interfere... Damn You, Hydaelyn!

33705.original: No matter. Blessing or no, you imperfect beings cannot hope to defeat me!

33707.original: Mark not the Dark Minion's subtle words. Only Light may banish the Darkness!

33709.original: I will show you <hex:021A020203>true<hex:021A020103> magic! Fires of creation─arise!

33710.original: Searing flames, cleanse all in the name of the one true god!

33711.original: Those tainted by Light cannot be suffered to live! Go forth, my shadows!

33712.original: Yet know that if I should perish, so too will the mortal within whose flesh I reside.

33713.original: Hmph. Yours was always a vain struggle.

33800.original: Mogglesguard, to arms! Your king has need of you!

33801.original: Hearken unto me, brave Mogglesguard! These villains must be vanquished!

33802.original: Hold fast, Mogglesguard! Together we shall cast them out!

33803.original: You shall suffer for your transgressions against my subjects!

33804.original: Mogglesguard, assemble! We must drive them out together, kupo!

33805.original: Our foe is formidable, kupo. But surely, they are no match for our king!

33807.original: And now our battle begins in earnest!

33808.original: To me, my Mogglesguard! We strike as one!

33809.original: You'll be blown to smithereens, kupo!

33902.original: Arrive at the Seat of the Foremost

33903.original: Clear the Seat of the Foremost

33904.original: Arrive in the Garden of Epopts

33906.original: It appears rats have wandered into my castle.

33907.original: Tear them apart if you must! Their drifting aether will suffice!

33908.original: That you should make it this far...<hex:02100103>No matter, I will devour you personally!

33911.original: H-How can this be? H-How could you resist my gaze?

33912.original: They're too strong... Someone else can devour them!

33916.original: I give you a taste of true dessspair!

33917.original: Stubborn mortals. I have not finished with you yet!

33918.original: No... I will not be defeated by you!

33921.original: Milk every last drop of their aether!

33923.original: Char them black! Char them black!

33929.original: Trapped in my own domain... No, I don't want to be eaten!

34000.original: DrAw YoUr WeApOn Of ChOiCe, AnD fAcE mE fAiR aNd SqUaRe!

34001.original: Who built this oversized mammet!?<hex:02100103>And why, oh why does it have those Amalj'aa limbs!?

34002.original: How is this fair!?<hex:02100103>It has an entire bank of artillery at its command!

34003.original: ThE iMpOsSiBlE cHoIcE...<hex:02100103>wIlL yOu TaStE sTeEl, Or WiThEr In FlAmE?

34004.original: ThE dEvIoUs SwItCh...<hex:02100103>A cLeVeR wArRiOr FoOlS tHe FoE!

34005.original: Its arms! They switched sides!<hex:02100103>What a dirty trick...

34006.original: I am vigilance unceasing...<hex:02100103>A final death unto the zombie horde!

34007.original: Zombie horde? Could this warrior have endured since the Thorne Dynasty...? But that was centuries ago!

34008.original: My wards will incinerate your undead flesh!

34013.original: Winds carry you to fiery doom!

34014.original: The flame will have its fuel!

34015.original: And still you shamble on! How hot must the fires burn to undo your foul animation!?

34016.original: My heart weeps that we must fell such a fierce ally of Ul'dah...

34017.original: Nald preserve me from creepers and crawlers.<hex:02100103>Pray clear the path, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

34018.original: What do they feed on down here? Each other? And why must it smell so positively putrid?

34019.original: ●削除：ふむ……。<hex:02100103>菌糸類が広がって、道を塞いでおるようじゃ。

34020.original: Even empty of pests, this place is a dank, mold-ridden nightmare. How long has it lain untended?

34021.original: Ugh! Pfbt! Pfbt! Thome of id fell in by bouth...<hex:02100103>Is adventuring always this disgusting!?

34022.original: I should rather not traverse a fungal bridge, but I suppose if we hurry across...

34023.original: The decay is especially bad in this section. I fear the fungal growth is all which keeps it from collapsing.

34024.original: Gah! You see!? Even the water is some ghastly shade of...wait. Is that ceruleum?

34025.original: If you can best a hecatoncheir so handily, then it certainly bodes well for the remainder of our expedition!

34026.original: To think that such a cavernous hollow yawns directly beneath Ul'dah!

34027.original: Raising one of these lifts should provide us passage across. Assuming, of course, that the winch yet functions...

34028.original: Interesting. The lift appears of Ul'dahn design, albeit an old one, but everything else screams “Amalj'aa.”

34029.original: Yes, most definitely Amalj'aa construction. Fortifications built for war, rather than habitation, I would say.

34030.original: Could this camp be from the time of the zombie purge? Was Father hoping I would see this one day...?

34031.original: Did <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> know that Ul'dahn and Amalj'aa once fought side by side? 'Tis not common knowledge.

34032.original: A door of solid iron─and no sign my key will open it.<hex:02100103>Do you see any handy levers or the like...?

34033.original: Unbeliever... You will proceed no further.<hex:02100103>Begone from this place.

34034.original: Who is speaking!? Well, I've not come this far to let a door turn me away. Break it down!

34035.original: Impressive! 'Tis akin to having my own personal battering ram!

34036.original: Disembodied voices, dimly lit staircases...<hex:02100103>It has the feel of a haunted crypt.

34037.original: なんと、アマルジャ族じゃと！？<hex:02100103>気をつけるのじゃ、何やら様子がおかしい……！

34038.original: A tragic end to a valiant warrior. He at least seemed unaware of his...affliction.

34039.original: Still, I must wonder how long this fallen hero slumbered here in cursed undeath. Trapped alone in this forgotten tomb...

34040.original: Though we worship different gods, I shall offer up a prayer for his peaceful repose all the same.

34041.original: Shall we make our return, then, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? There seems little reason to linger here.

34042.original: We've uncovered much and more─plenty enough to occupy my thoughts for the time being. You have my thanks!

34043.original: Impressive! A lifetime of adventure teaches one more than just battlecraft, I see.

34044.original: 'Tis so stately and subdued in here...<hex:02100103>I am reminded of Erralig's Burial Chamber.

34045.original: なんと、アマルジャ族じゃと！？<hex:02100103>気をつけるのじゃ、何やら様子がおかしい……！

34046.original: A tragic end to a valiant warrior. He at least seemed unaware of his...affliction.

34047.original: And yet so abhorrent was the zombie curse, even a hero of his obvious stature was sealed behind an iron door.

34048.original: If only that powder had never been concocted... Heavy do I feel the burden of my ancestors' sins this day.

34049.original: Shall we make our return, then, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? There seems little reason to linger here.

34050.original: We've uncovered much and more─plenty enough to occupy my thoughts for the time being. You have my thanks!

34051.original: Nay, this rot cannot be allowed to continue. The tunnels need reinforcement, not to mention a thorough cleaning...

34052.original: ヘカトンケイレス族にも後れを取らぬとは、さすがじゃ！<hex:02100103>この調子で、最後まで頼むぞ！

34053.original: 開けた場所に出たかと思えば……<hex:02100103>ウルダハの地下に、このような空間があったとは！

34054.original: ●そこのリフトで足場を上げれば、先へ進めそうじゃ。<hex:02100103>しかし、ずいぶんと古めかしい……ちゃんと動くかのう？

34055.original: Interesting. The lift appears of Ul'dahn design, albeit an old one, but everything else screams “Amalj'aa.”

34056.original: Yes, most definitely Amalj'aa construction. Fortifications built for war, rather than habitation, I would say.

34057.original: Drakes! Just like the ones the Amalj'aa tame! Is it me, or are some of these creatures awfully large...?

34058.original: You've triggered some spell of opening! I wonder why they chose to conceal this passage...

34059.original: Oh, I see! This must be where they stored their ritual materials.

34060.original: These are precious relics, every one. Think you they might be blessed or enchanted in some fashion?

34061.original: 'Tis so stately and subdued in here...<hex:02100103>I am reminded of Erralig's Burial Chamber.

34062.original: なんと、アマルジャ族じゃと！？<hex:02100103>気をつけるのじゃ、何やら様子がおかしい……！

34063.original: A tragic end to a valiant warrior. He at least seemed unaware of his...affliction.

34064.original: What cruel irony that a hero of the zombie purge would become the very thing he sought to vanquish.

34065.original: And how many of his kin shared his fate? I would lay them all to rest in the manner of their people...

34066.original: While it may not be the Amalj'aa way, I shall at least offer a prayer of peaceful repose for this tortured soul.

34067.original: Shall we make our return, then, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? There seems little reason to linger here.

34068.original: We've uncovered much and more─plenty enough to occupy my thoughts for the time being. You have my thanks!

34069.original: 'Tis to be expected the aqueducts would have their share of vermin. If you might play the role of exterminator...?

34070.original: And in mere moments, the way is clear! Hardly an inconvenience for our mighty champion.

34071.original: Surely you do not expect me to cross <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> rickety thing! Slowly, then...and no rocking the bridge!

34072.original: I specifically requested no rocking, bouncing, or jouncing! Gods above, I was almost pitched over the side...

34073.original: That gate looks awfully heavy. Let us try the handle, and hope these gears and chains do most of the lifting.

34074.original: Oh, it opened!<hex:02100103>I worried it may have rusted shut.

34075.original: The size of your opponent matters not, it seems! A reassuring thought as we delve further into the unknown!

34076.original: I am put in mind of mine own chambers, secret passageways and all. I wonder...

34077.original: Of course, this is the Sil'dihn royal palace!<hex:02100103>Look at this banner by the door here...

34078.original: And there, the throne of Sil'dih! How fortunate we are to have made such an historic discovery!

34079.original: Ah...I've seen such contrivances before. We must balance the scales ere we can proceed.

34080.original: Simply a matter of selecting the correct weights! Surely you recognize one or two of these symbols, yes?

34082.original: That gap is rather wide... Barring some unlikely acrobatics on my part, I am afraid we are at an impasse.

34083.original: Oh, but what of these levers? Their position seems highly suggestive of their relation to yon yawning pit.

34084.original: Heavens forfend... Am I to trust in this wind to carry me over!?

34085.original: How undignified! I shall be seeking out an alternate route for the return trip!
