35217.original: <creak> Regimen complete. Evaluation ranking: 3.<hex:02100103>A spectacular performance. Such strength might even prove a match for Galatea herself were she still alive.

35218.original: <creak> Regimen complete. Evaluation ranking: 2.<hex:02100103>Impossible... Only Rullus has achieved such a feat.

35219.original: <creak> Regimen complete. Evaluation ranking: 1.<hex:02100103>Even the great rulers of voidsent would struggle to contend with such strength.

35220.original: <creak> Regimen complete.<hex:02100103>An equal to Drusilla. Extraordinary...

35227.original: Careful up there─you're not like to see much through the snow.

35228.original: おっと、開けたところに出たなァ。<hex:02100103>くれぐれも落ちなさんなよ！

35229.original: Hopefully that's the last of those winged bastards...<hex:02100103>I'm afraid this is as far as the mammoth'll go. You'll have to make it the rest of the way on foot.

35300.original: This is quite a crowd of admirers. Did someone send word we were coming?

35301.original: Ohoho! Shall we do a little dance?

35302.original: So many partners to choose from!

35303.original: Your lackeys were found lacking!<hex:02100103>Come out and face your fate!

35304.original: Insolent worms!<hex:02100103>The son will be the first to die...

35305.original: Mummy!<hex:02100103>Er...Daddy! If you could be so kind!

35306.original: You survived my missiles!?<hex:02100103>Then enjoy some leftover warmachina!

35307.original: This seems a sturdier group than the last!

35308.original: Oho! They may indeed survive a few more taps of the hammer!

35309.original: My warmachina... If reasonable means fail, then unreasonable measures are called for!

35310.original: Stand back, Hildibrand.<hex:02100103>Let your old man handle this.

35311.original: Very well...<hex:02100103>It seems I must crush you myself!

35312.original: Ohohoho!<hex:02100103>Finally decided to take us seriously, have you?

35313.original: Prepare to pay for your crimes, Doctor!

35314.original: Hah hah hah!<hex:02100103>I've had worse chigoe bites!

35315.original: Ah! I do enjoy some light exercise!

35316.original: What...what manner of fiend are you!?

35317.original: No mortal man could avoid such a barrage...

35318.original: Strange. I swear I felt a snowflake fall on me...

35319.original: Hah hah hah!<hex:02100103>Hildibrand's mother hits harder than that!

35321.original: The hardiness of these Mandervilles, it's...<hex:02100103>It's unnatural!

35323.original: My thanks, Father...<hex:02100103>That could have been worse.

35324.original: Impossible!<hex:02100103>The son is as unbreakable as the father!

35325.original: Ah, a mild zap to improve the circulation!<hex:02100103>Invigorating!

35326.original: That was exciting!<hex:02100103>Mayhap I should have let it hit me.

35327.original: How!? That much power should have rattled the teeth from his skull!

35328.original: Are we playing a game here!?<hex:02100103>Is he <hex:021A020203>enjoying<hex:021A020103> this!?

35329.original: You aggravating vermin!<hex:02100103>My plans are in ruins!

35330.original: The doctor leaves himself wide open!<hex:02100103>Let us seize the advantage!

35331.original: This move was meant for another, but you've earned my ire!

35332.original: I have more surprises!<hex:02100103>This one may shock you!

35339.original: An amusing diversion, but you'll need to do better than that.

35341.original: You've forced my hand...<hex:02100103>I'll bring this place down on your heads!

35400.original: Connection to biological organism Artorius stable. Initiate elimination protocol.

35401.original: Deploying Dimensional Bla─ Bzzzt... This...sword... I remember...you...

35402.original: Deploying Dimensional Blade. Power output comparable to original weapon.

35404.original: Maximizing aether output in preparation for thermal divide...

35405.original: All aether cores free. Initiate paradox protocol─releasing extinction waves!

35406.original: Damage to biological organism exceeds safe levels. Regenerative processes impeded─ Bzzzt... Release...me...

35407.original: Intruders persist. Enemies of the empire must be purged.

35408.original: Generating attack module. Initiate synchronous strike.

35500.original: A deal is a deal...<hex:02170103>I cannot let you pass.

35502.original: Ah, this land brims with life... Ripe for the harvest!

35504.original: Such insolence! I will not be denied!

35507.original: Thank goodness we're not too late. Can you still fight?

35509.original: Hah hah hah! Yes, more mortals come to slaughter!

35510.original: My strength is spent...<hex:02170103>I'll only get in your way.

35512.original: Chin up! We'll get through this together!

35517.original: I will enjoy draining your aether, watching as the life dims in your eyes.

35520.original: If you would deny me my feast, then begone! To ashes with you!

35521.original: Do not let them get away!

35523.original: This has gone on long enough!

35527.original: No! NO! Why won't you die!?

35529.original: Coordinate with your comrades and defeat the voidsent horde

35530.original: Protect Zero until she is ready to retaliate

35700.original: The archfiend of fire has no equal!

35701.original: You've strength worthy enough of pride.

35703.original: I am one with the flames...

35705.original: You are the first to behold this form.

35708.original: Flames to lick at your heels.

35710.original: So brightly do the flames burn!

35712.original: Look now on my essence made pure...

35723.original: 'Tis time to bring this to an end.

35725.original: I shall restore you to full strength.

35727.original: Allow me to show you real flame!

35800.original: You are the Alpha, I am the Omega.<hex:02100103><blip> Initiating direct analysis of subject group.

35801.original: <bleep> Pantokrator mode engaged.<hex:02100103>Rerouting logic resources to armament generation...

35802.original: I am the Omega and the Alpha.<hex:02100103>I will mimic your weakness to comprehend your strength.

35803.original: <blip> Diverting energy to party member generation.<hex:02100103>Testing efficacy of combat role allocation...

35804.original: Disengaging inhibitors to simulate improbable performance.

35805.original: Evaluation. Imitation of mortal form and behavior provides negligible improvement to combat capabilities.

35806.original: Final analysis. Drastic overhaul of combat logic required.<hex:02100103>Initiating reconfiguration sequence.

35808.original: Experiment concluded.<hex:02100103>I am the Alpha. I am the Omega.

35809.original: <blip> <bleep> FoR rIFt ENergY uNnecEsSAry iT iS?<hex:02100103>oUtPut mAXimiZeD, BUg mAss pROducTIOn...<hex:02100103><bleep> hELLo, WOrlD!?

35813.original: <bleep> Structural limitations of chassis exceeded...<hex:02100103>Disregard. Objective incomplete.

35818.original: Amplification inconsistent with inhibitor disengagement values. Potential evidence of undefined mortal strength?

35819.original: Begin hypothesis. Based on the premise that performing beyond physical parameters is not a biological function...

35820.original: Evaluation failed. Unable to harness full potential of indefinable power...

35821.original: I am the Omega, and I walk with the Alpha.<hex:02100103>Where one ends, another begins.

35825.original: Your thoughts, they are...comprehensible.<hex:02100103>Yes. Together, we may prevail.

35827.original: Further testing is required.<hex:02100103><hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, assist me with this evaluation.

35828.original: The path I recorded through the great expanse...

35829.original: The piercing rays of ten million suns...

35830.original: The flames which incinerated the Dragonstar...

35831.original: The velocity of a wyrm, surging across the cosmos...

35832.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, the test nears its conclusion. Witness the extent to which I have evolved!

35833.original: The colossal impact which invites extinction...

35834.original: I ranked the mortals I encountered on this star among the most feeble of species.

35835.original: Yet you demonstrated incomprehensible strength in your triumphs. A mystery in defiance of all logic.

35836.original: At last, with Alpha's insight and assistance, I have succeeded in harnessing this unmeasurable might.

35837.original: My experiment has accomplished its purpose...and I will prove it by claiming this victory!

35900.original: Commencing memory fabrication... Thou standest before Tiamat, guardian of Meracydia.

35901.original: Go forth, my children! Drive these foul invaders from our home!

35902.original: My boundless rage shall swallow thee whole!

35903.original: The flames of retribution consume thee!

35904.original: Bear witness to the power of the first brood!

36001.original: Consciousness injection successful. Commencing attack protocol.

36002.original: Sustained enemy presence detected. Threat level increased and attack pattern elevated in intensity.

36100.original: Welcome one, welcome all, to Kageyama's Clockwork Castletown! Gahahaha!

36101.original: Fires and fights are the flowers of Kugane! Now, entertain me, peasants!

36102.original: Hm, needs more sound and fury... Let the parade commence!

36103.original: Dance, my puppets, dance! But have care where you wander...

36104.original: Now, you can't expect clockwork to do all the work for you.

36105.original: Oh, I seem to have dropped a coin. And another. And another!

36201.original: Death brings me no peace... Such is my fate...

36202.original: Few can wield such power as mine!

36204.original: My every breath is laced with magicks!

36206.original: Always more killin' to be done... And I'm always happy to oblige!

36207.original: Make it fun for me, eh?

36208.original: The first drops are always the sweetest!

36216.original: It ain't a fight till the dying begins!

36218.original: I'll leave you bloody and battered!

36306.original: Three paths to be unsealed at our behest. Whither shall we wander?

36307.original: You thought to go down this path as well? How reassuring!

36308.original: Interested in a different path? I shall place my trust in your intuition.

36309.original: A grand gate. What lies beyond, I wonder?

36310.original: I espy a most promising pagoda! Let us make it our destination.

36311.original: What curious creatures! They must have been emboldened by these terrible torrents.

36312.original: Mountain weather is wont to change on a whim, but 'tis not nature's whims at work here...

36313.original: Thank the kami the rains have ceased... We should make for shelter ere another storm passes through.

36314.original: Such tumultuous spirits! Servants of the wind, no doubt.

36315.original: These winds could blow a man away...and will, if we do not tread carefully!

36316.original: A thousand thousand paths...and yours ends here.

36319.original: We are everything and nothing─your first and final breath!

36321.original: Slayer of spirits... Their fate will soon be yours!

36322.original: Your soul is mine to claim! Your marrow, mine to burn...

36323.original: These treasures are mine! All <hex:021A020203>mine<hex:021A020103>! You shall not sully their brilliance!

36324.original: The head monk, I take it? And bearing a form befitting his proclivities...

36325.original: 火の神より賜りし力よ……<hex:02100103>琵琶の響きで、燃え立ち猛れ！

36326.original: 火の神より賜りし力よ……<hex:02100103>琵琶の音色で、分かれて増えよ！

36327.original: Beware the biwa's melody, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! It resounds with power...

36328.original: 専門外なので私にはさっぱりデスが、<hex:02100103>アナタなら、演奏の違いもわかるのでは……？

36329.original: A song to guide you to your grave!

36330.original: Beads to bind the spirit's form...<hex:02100103>With these words, be reborn!

36333.original: Hee hee! You thought you were free of me!

36334.original: Divine thunder, heed my call─bestow upon my biwa your tumultuous timbre!

36335.original: My power will see you humbled!

36336.original: A drink to fuel the fires of my fury!

36337.original: Ahahaha! You are as nothing before my might!

36341.original: Divine fire, I beseech thee─cleanse the branded with blessed flame!

36342.original: Divine thunder, heed my call─sound to rend the very earth!

36343.original: There is no salvation for thieves... I offer you death, and nothing more!

36344.original: It shall be mine...mine, I say! You cannot have it!

36345.original: The dance of a thousand petals begins with a single blossom!

36346.original: Wayward flowers, bend to my will!

36350.original: In summer's blaze do my blades sing... In winter's chill do they bite!

36351.original: The sky weeps, and the earth heeds her call!

36352.original: Death blooms in a raging tempest!

36353.original: Come forth, dear friends, and beguile mine enemies!

36354.original: Solitary leaves, I call upon you─fly at the mercy of the storm!

36355.original: Reeds of the earth, take to the skies!

36356.original: From accursed boughs do wicked buds bloom!

36357.original: Under normal circumstances, I would find this ninjutsu endearing... Would that her petals did not seek to do us harm!

36358.original: The blossoms must be enchanted. Keep a watchful eye on how they fly, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

36359.original: I should like to pat their fluffy little heads, but a well-trained pup will go to great lengths to protect its master...

36360.original: Face me, and I shall grant you an honorable death!

36361.original: My blade thirsts for mortal blood!

36362.original: To me, my warriors! Your lord has need of you!

36363.original: That my blade could miss its mark... You are a formidable foe.

36364.original: In tenebrous night shall you meet your end...

36365.original: In gardens of flame do true warriors thrive!

36366.original: War is a sea of sorrow, and you shall drown!

36368.original: My ire is an infernal flame, never to be smothered!

36369.original: Our spirits are as the wind, never to be fettered!

36370.original: To arms, my warriors! We make for the front lines!

36371.original: I once dreamed of shaking hands with a giant oni, but not like this!

36372.original: They may have strength in numbers, but worry not! If you cannot beat them, dodge them, I say!

36373.original: Thank the kami the winds have ceased... We should make for shelter ere we are blown back to the foot of the mountain!

36374.original: If I had to wager a guess, these must be the temple's stores. Rather spacious, aren't they?

36375.original: Were I a treasure─cursed or no─I imagine I would abide within these walls. But where...

36376.original: Under the auspices of two auspices, as it were. Curious.

36377.original: So the glass serves as a magicked doorknob of sorts? The monks were certainly inventive...

36378.original: You too are a connoisseur of Far Eastern maps, I trust? Terribly charming, how the Four Lords are shown ruling the cardinal directions.

36380.original: I might have known that Suzaku and Seiryu were the guardians of this gateway─though in fairness, one usually needs grapple with only one at a time.

36381.original: ...Would that we had arrived sooner. Judging by her supernatural size, the demons have already taken that poor shinobi.

36382.original: She must be in the thrall of a treasure. A promising lead...though at an unfortunate cost.

36383.original: I see no clockwork mechanisms... We've an honest-to-kami mononoke on our hands.

36384.original: The bloodlust is palpable... Have care, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I shall be right here─at a reasonably safe distance─cheering you on!

36385.original: Excellent work, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I knew from the first you would emerge victori─

36386.original: ...What, pray tell, is that look for?

36387.original: Your faith in my faith in you aside, you may be interested to know that I recognize the detailing on this armor. It once belonged to a renowned warrior.

36388.original: Would that my falcon had the freight capacity of a barge...

36389.original: Alas, I suppose I must choose which artifacts to leave behind─for now.

36390.original: Well done, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Even the fiercest mononoke is no match for you!

36391.original: 'Tis difficult to appreciate while under threat of slicing and dicing, but the monks amassed a truly impressive collection of blades here.

36392.original: To say naught of our most enspirited armor!

36393.original: Perhaps the soul of the warrior who once wore it yet lingered, awaiting his chance to take to the battlefield once more...

36394.original: Or perhaps his sword was a treasure with a life of its own.

36395.original: A vexing conundrum─what to bring back to Kugane, that is. I don't suppose you've space in your bag...?

36396.original: Well done, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! You are an unholy terror on the battlefield─and I mean that in the most flattering way.

36397.original: To think that our secret passage would lead us to such an immaculate armory... Perhaps the monks utilized this as a shelter in times of strife.

36398.original: I doubt they expected the armor they stored to come to life, however. Quite the harrowing foe, that one.

36399.original: ...Which leads me to believe that the armor itself must be one of the treasures we seek!

36400.original: Despite its storied history, it looks almost pristine. I suspect the monks tended to it regularly.

36401.original: It shall prove quite the challenge to bring back...but I daresay my falcon and I are up to the task! Pray accept my unending gratitude for your assistance, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

36402.original: A clash for the ages! Life-threatening circumstances aside, 'tis always a pleasure to witness bushido at work.

36403.original: I had guessed the passage we traversed would lead us to the stores' most valuable contents─lo and behold!

36404.original: Such exceptional relics are a rarity indeed...this armor not least of all.

36405.original: The spirit that enlivened it may have been one of the very tsukumogami of rumor.

36406.original: In an ideal world, I would not hesitate to bring home every last blade the mononoke touched... Alas, my falcon can only bear so much weight.

36407.original: This calls for serious consideration... Pray leave me to my thoughts for a moment.

36408.original: How pleasingly picturesque! Had we no demons to slay, I would suggest a more leisurely stroll.

36409.original: I shudder to think of the chaos should those creatures find their way to civilization...

36410.original: I suppose we're obliged to take the scenic route.

36411.original: That ahead is Shojo Temple, home to Gorai and his accursed collection!

36412.original: If only we had time for the typical ablutions... But a proper pilgrimage must wait for another day.

36413.original: For now, treasure awaits! As do the monk and his minions, of course. Do have care.

36414.original: I admit that I was equally tempted to pull that rope, though part of me wishes you hadn't...

36415.original: The statues keep silent vigil in their masters' absence...but they are not the treasures we seek. Onward!

36416.original: The temple stretches on ever further. Step lively, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! We've plenty to explore.

36417.original: Even the inner sanctum is plagued with demons. If any who remained did survive, 'twould be nothing short of a miracle.

36418.original: Splendid as these statues are, they appear lacking in the “accursed” aspect. Our quarry must lie further in.

36419.original: Though the temple's isolation is a blessing for the smallfolk, I imagine it made the monks' experience all the more harrowing...

36420.original: We have yet to see hide nor hair of Gorai...

36421.original: Breathtaking! 'Tis as though the majestic tiger it depicts might pounce off the screen at any─ Oh?

36422.original: That was <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> an invitation! Your assistance, please, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

36423.original: That precarious pile of crates is a mountain unto itself!

36424.original: Somehow, I doubt that brute has learned its lesson... But let us continue on.

36425.original: By the kami, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, how did you get up there?

36426.original: Adventurers and their climbing... Why, just the other day, on Kugane Tower─ But perhaps that is a tale for another time.

36427.original: That sounded promising... If you suddenly hear my winsome wailing, you had best come running!

36428.original: Ah, a secret stairwell! How very convenient.

36429.original: Both master and minion, irascible to the last...

36430.original: Tokimori's words ring true. These creatures allow for not a modicum of mercy.

36431.original: With your victory, we may now free the mountain of Gorai's influence─by liberating these treasures from his collection, of course.

36432.original: Any one of them may have harbored spiritual forces. Perhaps all of them─it would certainly explain Gorai's impressive transformation.

36433.original: As for which deserves a place in my collection... Gorai's biwa, of course! A fine addition.

36434.original: And with that, we may be on our way. Your company has been a pleasure as always, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

36435.original: And so the demon is slain!

36436.original: Though his avarice availed him curious tools, your skill carried the day.

36437.original: One wonders what artifacts he might have unveiled had you waited a touch longer to deal the killing blow...but there's naught to be done about it now.

36438.original: Naught but to take the lesson of his life to heart, perhaps. Never shirk the proper appraisal of items with dubious histories!

36439.original: Bearing this firmly in mind, I shall help myself to that hammer of his.

36440.original: 'Twas an honor and a privilege to accompany you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Shall we begin our preparations for the journey back?

36441.original: Admirable as always, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Few would be so keen to face down a rat of that size.

36442.original: To say naught of his unusual sousing. When the unholy draught touched his lips, I feared his fury would consume the entire temple.

36443.original: I should like to know precisely what baleful influence was wrought upon the drink...but not enough to test it myself.

36444.original: Nay, I must bring back a less volatile artifact of our endeavors...

36445.original: The living lanterns─chochin, as the Hingans say─were particularly fascinating, were they not?

36446.original: Now that they are returned to their original form, I may safely seek to learn more of the spirits they once harbored. Let us add them to my collection forthwith!

36447.original: Curious... This lantern shines differently than the rest. The mononoke's influence, perhaps?

36448.original: No, some other mechanism. What if I...

36449.original: Lesson learned, Hancock─do <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> prod eerily glowing objects!

36450.original: In any case, the monks went to great pains to conceal this path. What could have warranted such secrecy?

36451.original: Kami forfend! We could suffocate under this wicked haze...

36452.original: I'd wager the tsukumogami is the pipe itself─its body a mere illusion.

36453.original: A brilliant display! With the demonic smoke dispelled, we may breathe easy once more.

36454.original: Only an entity of great power could transform its surrounds so dramatically. You did well to outmaneuver it.

36455.original: Now, I espied something resting within the shrine earlier...

36456.original: I have seen depictions of this pipe before. There can be no doubt that it is an age-old treasure.

36457.original: Gorai must have known that a fierce tsukumogami slumbered within it. Thus he stored it apart, far from the sanctity of the temple...

36458.original: But its will was too strong to be consigned to such ignominy, and in its neglect, its power only grew. Until it was strong enough to enshroud the mount entire...

36459.original: Now that this lord among demons is slain, we can assume that peace shall return to the region. We must report the good news to Mistress Tsubaki posthaste!

36460.original: I─and my growing collection─should not have fared half so well without you here. I am in your debt!

36461.original: Shrink before my might! Quiver in awe!

36462.original: A path straight up the holy mount, is it? How refreshingly dangerous!

36463.original: Why, these hills stretch on for malms! Would that they were not alive with the sound of demons.

36464.original: The Hingans call these clay figures “dogu”─but why is one here, of all places?

36465.original: Best to let sleeping dogu lie. For all we know, it could be cursed.

36466.original: If that dogu turns on us, its extermination shall be <hex:021A020203>your<hex:021A020103> responsibility, I hope you know!

36467.original: Fallen leaves and fresh greenery in such close proximity? 'Tis passing strange.

36468.original: There are few things more breathtaking than autumnal leaves...even if they are out of season. The influence of a treasure, I suspect.

36469.original: I understand you adventurers enjoy the roads less traveled, but─ And there <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> goes. Courage, Hancock!

36470.original: Such a tranquil place, these mountain heights. By the look of it, I presume it is not a path that many tread.

36471.original: Hmm... 'Tis not the first of those stones we've encountered. Do they serve as shrines of some sort?

36472.original: No shrine is built without purpose...or so I have heard. If such is the case, then what might this one be for?

36473.original: Oho! I knew from the first that the dogu was meant for something greater.

36474.original: I, for one, have <hex:021A020203>naught but respect<hex:021A020103> for our new clay comrade! ...Do you think it can hear us?

36475.original: The warding talismans on this boulder give me pause...but it shall serve as well as any bridge, I suppose.

36476.original: One cannot go wrong with a rustic log bridge─assuming the trunk is free of angry spirits, of course...

36477.original: Gods be good! I know not how, but the statue has awakened...and it did <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> wake on the right side of the proverbial bed!

36478.original: Just a moment─I have read of this before! If I am not mistaken, that mononoke is Shishio, king among nue!

36479.original: Even a king of beasts is no match for you, I see! Well done, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

36480.original: The most, in a word, <hex:021A020203>vivid<hex:021A020103> Shishio myth tells of its ravenous rampage across the countryside. It had quite the appetite for mortal flesh!

36481.original: 'Tis also said that its harrowing cry is a harbinger of misfortune, but I say we should consider ourselves lucky to have chanced upon a living legend.

36482.original: As for what freed it of its lithic bonds... Perhaps the revelry of its fellow mononoke roused its fighting spirit.

36483.original: Alas, the beast held no treasures of Gorai's, but fret not─I shall make do with what we have here and claim a suitable souvenir.

36484.original: Though our hike was fraught with peril, 'twas exhilarating in equal measure! You have my thanks, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

36485.original: A deed fit for legend! Quite literally, for Shishio appears in countless Hingan myths.

36486.original: One, in fact, tells of a wayfaring warrior who triumphed over it long ago.

36487.original: As such, I was aware that its harrowing cry could warp the very earth...but to see it firsthand is a wholly different beast, I'm sure you agree.

36488.original: Though the creature bore none of Gorai's treasures, we can take comfort in the knowledge that it will terrorize Lord Uzumibi's people no more.

36489.original: ...And in the no less valuable artifacts we've spotted over the course of our journey to the summit, naturally.

36490.original: All that remains is to carry the spoils to our waiting falcons. I trust I can count on you?

42209.original: Watch out, it's a veritable storm of needles!

42210.original: There's something missing... Oh, I know!

42211.original: Quicksand!? You don't want to get caught in that!

42212.original: Oh no! The challenger's been sucked in!

42213.original: What do you say to a refreshing riverscape?

42215.original: This is no good! It needs a touch of thunder, a dash of downpour!

42216.original: A thunderstorm has turned the waters muddy! How frightening!

42217.original: I have it! Some destruction to facilitate deconstruction!

42218.original: A massive, raging storm! I hope you brought your parasols!

42219.original: You've sparked my imagination! The ideas fairly erupt!

42220.original: Lava is ravaging the ring! Talk about destructive creativity!

42221.original: Pudding alone gets awfully dull, don't you think?

42222.original: A transformative piece! The fiend has been completely remade!

42224.original: What do you think of this?

42226.original: You've reminded me of something truly important: art must be free!

42300.original: Upon my blade I swear, no harm shall come to Her Highness!

42301.original: You will not defile Zelenia's memory any longer!

42311.original: Feel the sting of my divine blade!

42313.original: I know this technique... You must keep moving!

42315.original: That her bladework should be recreated so faithfully...

42316.original: Have care! Zelenia was capable of much, much more!

42318.original: I will show you the soul of a royal knight!

42319.original: For the honor and glory of Alexandria, I strike!

42320.original: This is her deadliest technique...but you must endure!

42321.original: Behold the essence of my art!

42322.original: You've no time even to fear my wrath!

42326.original: The sigils channel magic! Be on your guard!

42327.original: You must brace for blade and magic both!

42329.original: You must take care when avoiding the sigils!

42330.original: I have pledged my life to the kingdom!

42335.original: I will suffer none to threaten Alexandria!

42336.original: I am sworn to protect my queen! I will die before I yield!

42337.original: That's right... Zelenia was always there to protect me...

42338.original: I know this is merely a reconstruction...and yet...

42339.original: For the honor and glory of Alexandria, I strike!

42401.original: Are you ready to get down?

42403.original: Can you keep up with the rhythm?

42404.original: Dancing Green is pulling out all the stops with these steps!

42405.original: We're just getting started! Keep groovin', baby!

42406.original: On the dance floor, everyone's a star!

42407.original: Bask in the spotlight and burn, baby, burn!

42408.original: An invitation to dance! How will the challenger respond?

42411.original: Let's turn up the heat! Try to keep up, now!

42412.original: The fever's taken hold! Can the upstart keep up with Dancing Green?

42415.original: You're burnin' up the dance floor, baby!

42416.original: Groovy moves! The crowd's lovin' it!

42417.original: Not bad, but I reckon you've got more in you!

42418.original: Hey, what're you tryin' to do, put the crowd to sleep?

42420.original: Yeah, baby! I feel the fever comin' on again!

42421.original: The night's reached a fever pitch! All eyes are on Dancing Green!

42424.original: Let's bring the night to a scorchin' close!

42425.original: That was one helluva party! Let's do it again sometime!

42506.original: Chateau d'Oraguille...? Is this meant to be San d'Oria?

42507.original: Ronfaure is supposed to be a quiet place that sees its fair share of new adventurers...

42508.original: A burning circle, here? It would appear the land has been altered...

42509.original: This is Horlais Peak... We must be ready for anything.

42510.original: It seems we've impressed Kirin! Let us keep up the good work!

42511.original: The Jeuno Armada. But what is there to gain from recreating this battle?

42512.original: It's Ultima and Omega! And they're attacking those airships!

42513.original: Ultima and Omega are on a rampage... Who unleashed them?

42514.original: I do not see an easy way back... But I'm sure you can handle things without me!

42515.original: At this rate, everything will be laid to waste...

42516.original: しばらく合流は難しそうだ……！<hex:02100103>すまないが、そいつらを止めてくれ！

42517.original: ...But it would appear I've landed on the wrong airship.

42518.original: An impressive show. Hurry, now─do not keep me waiting.

42519.original: You shall find me at the summit.

42520.original: Farewell, my little brother. Return to the crystal from which you were born.

42521.original: You have the privilege of walking within the heart of Tu'Lia. Do <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> disappoint me.

42522.original: Come, then. Show me what your kind can do.

42523.original: Behold the glory of the Zilart.

42524.original: You are naught but insects to be crushed.

42525.original: O Sublime Estoc, drink deep of the elements!

42527.original: Careful, now. The face of war is ever-changing!

42528.original: Kneel before Zilartian wisdom and die.

42529.original: This is the power of crystals. Transcendent. Sublime!

42530.original: By their might, I pave the path to Paradise!

42531.original: I am the will of the crystal!

42532.original: さらばだ、道化の猿どもよ。<hex:02100103>おまえたちの役目は終わった、世界の終わりが始まるのだ。

42533.original: That you should still stand... Very well, then!

42534.original: I thank you for this amusement!

42535.original: Wh-Why? I am the will...of the crystal... How could I be defeated by mere mortals...?

42536.original: As for the rest of you, I invite you to the Gate of the Gods.

42537.original: You, who have risen above your mortal status... I am Kirin.

42538.original: Kirin could never be summoned here. More meddling from that fiend Sareel Ja, no doubt.

42540.original: O guardians divine, lend me now your might!

42541.original: O Suzaku, conjure your infernal flames!

42542.original: O Seiryu, scatter blood upon the wind!

42543.original: O Byakko, rend with fang and claw!

42544.original: O Genbu, entomb in rock and earth!

42546.original: This surging power, I bring to bear!

42547.original: This is no power I've seen before... But I won't be daunted!

42551.original: You shall reap the rewards for daring to contend with the gods!

42553.original: Hah, nary a scratch! Well done!

42554.original: A comrade is in trouble! Someone heal them!

42555.original: A comrade is down! Someone revive them!

42556.original: A truly mighty blow! The adventurers of your world are extraordinary indeed!

42558.original: Such adamant defense... Our unbreakable resolve made manifest!

42559.original: I fear I cannot shield against this assault alone. Shields, with me!

42560.original: This world shall belong to the Zilart.

42562.original: Can you escape this, I wonder.

42563.original: Allow me to show you a trick I've learned!

42564.original: Even in this false flesh, I will not lose to you!

42565.original: You fought well, but it's time to say good-bye.

42566.original: This is not Vana'diel. I'm well aware of that.

42567.original: I also understand the true nature of my existence. So come, let us finish this.

42568.original: I will eliminate you and make this world ours!

42569.original: The time for games is over. Behold my true power!

42570.original: I shall forge a more fitting stage for our battle.

42571.original: I do so hope you'll live up to my expectations.

42600.original: Loath as I am to employ medicines in the application of harm, I <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> protect my patients.

42602.original: A potent concoction, this one.<hex:02100103>...I am sorry, but you must be stopped.

42609.original: Ah, you've come. I'll begin by wearing you down.

42610.original: I've created new Endless for you. Not all are warriors, but they will follow orders.

42611.original: “Kill” and “survive” and so forth. Here, I shall prepare the stage for battle.

42612.original: The memories of a physician. One who saves lives should be reluctant to die.

42613.original: Oh, you've overburdened the system. No matter. It served its purpose.

42614.original: Next, we visit a prison of sinister repute. I need not compel them to fight.

42615.original: These are loyal executioners. They shall deal appropriately with “criminals.”

42616.original: Beginning to tire? Good. I bid you continue on.

42617.original: Memories from an age rife with death... The desperation will serve well.

42618.original: The enemy is at the gate. To arms, good soldiers─protect your kingdom.

42619.original: An amalgam of memories. Let us see how it fares.

42620.original: It is the midst of the Storm Surge.

42621.original: Countless lives are lost in the senseless conflict.

42622.original: The war swells in scope and intensity.

42623.original: The bombs rain down without pause or mercy.

42624.original: The spark of life is dimmed with every blinding flash.

42625.original: Death is everywhere, pillaging the promise of the future.

42626.original: Your sentence is death. How long can you defy it?

42627.original: Criminals may run, but they cannot escape.

42800.original: Your precious Light shall feed my vengeance...

42802.original: Shackles of flame, bind my foe!

42804.original: Rise from the abyss, O mighty flame.

42806.original: I shall bathe in your blood.

42812.original: A curse of Light consume you.

42814.original: You are finished... The abyss take you!

42815.original: Thank you for agreeing to help decorate the cakes, kupo!

42816.original: 'Tis a simple matter of carrying the ingredients from the shelves around the room to the central cake stands.

42817.original: There is, of course, the matter of the mammet pâtissiers. Should they spot you, use the whistle to temporarily disable them!

42820.original: Once you have an ingredient in hand, bring it to the cake stand in the center, kupo!

42821.original: Take care to avoid the mammet pâtissiers!

42822.original: All that remains is to decorate the cake!

42825.original: The ingredients are on shelves around the room! Fetch the ingredients in the recipe, kupo!

42826.original: Collect the required ingredients and decorations to add the finishing touches to as many cakes as you can.

42827.original: The mammets are moving more quickly. Take care, kupo!

42828.original: Kupopo! Watch out─the mammets seem even madder than before!

42829.original: The <hex:02281BFF1656616C656E74696F6E537765657473526563697065E8020103> is complete! And what a fine cake it looks!

42831.original: It's the final cake! Let your inspiration guide you!

42832.original: Choose the frosting, decorations, and cake toppers that make your heart sing!

42833.original: I believe we're out of time, kupo!

42834.original: But we haven't much time, kupo... Make haste!

42835.original: I believe we're out of time, kupo!

42836.original: The final cake is decorated splendidly, kupo!

42842.original: Thank you for your wonderful help, kupo! I can hardly wait to complete our delivery...

42843.original: Everyone has their off days─do not take it to heart!

42844.original: To think you'd decorate five whole cakes... You have proven yourself the master of confection and affection alike, kupo!

42845.original: Four cakes is quite something. You have a knack for cake decorating, kupo!

42846.original: Three cakes, kupo! This should be a feast!

42847.original: Two cakes─this makes you a fully fledged pâtissier, kupo!

42848.original: This cake shall more than suffice. As long as you put your heart into it, you've captured the spirit of Valentione's Day, kupo!

42849.original: Our guests will be most delighted. Let us return to the festivities posthaste!

42850.original: The ingredients you need are no doubt twinkling with anticipation, kupo!

42853.original: Find the source of the screams

42855.original: Best make sure the evacuation route is clear first...

42856.original: Done! Now to aid those people by the canal...

42859.original: That breeze is awfully warm... Oh no!

42861.original: Not a moment too soon... I hope that was the worst of it.

42864.original: I'll take care of this─make for shelter!

42868.original: If I never see another storm...

42869.original: Nowhere is safe with so many of them...

42870.original: Some friendly winds, if you please!

42873.original: The levin grows more volatile... Something is coming.

42876.original: The two of us will disperse these balls of lightning!

42878.original: The tide is turning. Press the attack!

42881.original: I can still fight! I can!

42883.original: How fortunate that bird made such an impression.

42884.original: Just keep the lightning at bay a little longer!

42900.original: You are bound by the limits of flesh. It will betray you.

42901.original: Fear compounds fear, eroding your strength.

42902.original: Do you not see? Death is upon you...

42904.original: You will die for me now.

42905.original: Accepting death is the greatest sin a life can commit.

42906.original: Those who do not resist death deserve it.

42907.original: Still alive. But there are ways to change that.

42910.original: I will reduce you to aether.

42913.original: Once the terror takes root, it will only continue to grow.

42916.original: And here it ends for you.

43106.original: No matter how many come, we fight hand in hand! Forevermore!

43107.original: 君たち、旅人さんか！？<hex:02100103>みんな街の奥へ避難してるから、そこを目指すといい！

43300.original: You called, my sapling?<hex:02100103>May all who threaten you know my wrath!

43400.original: We're in it now... I'm counting on you!

43403.original: Not again... You all right back there?

43404.original: Use the transport panels to get up there!

43405.original: How many times is it going to do that!?

43406.original: What in the─ You're still on board, right!?

43408.original: I have to disconnect the car. Quick, jump on the next one!

43501.original: Hahaha... Will you cry out in pleasure, or pain?

43502.original: Feast your eyes on the lovely─and lethal─Vamp Fatale!

43503.original: Will the challenger fall prey to the cruel mistress?

43505.original: This is my show. I will hear you scream.

43506.original: A wicked weapon! Vamp Fatale's poised to execute a fatality!

43507.original: You will become a stain on this ring.

43508.original: The challenger has nowhere left to run!

43509.original: This is just the beginning. My faithful minions─give me your aether!

43510.original: It's begun! She's draining the audience─of their aether!

43511.original: All of you will feed me.

43512.original: Vamp Fatale's unleashed the aether! The challenger's in her realm now!

43513.original: You are a stubborn one. But it is not too late to beg for mercy!

43514.original: The spectacle of slaughter resumes! How will the challenger adapt?

43515.original: It's a veritable rain of death!

43516.original: Such insolence I have never known! More─I need more aether!

43517.original: She's draining the crowd's aether again! I hope our dear spectators are feeling alright...

43519.original: She's unleashed even more aether! How will this end!?

43521.original: It's still not enough. I will take everything you have!

43522.original: The seductress is at it again! I...I'm feeling a little lightheaded...

43600.original: <sigh> What a chore. Must you soil the floor of my paradise?

43601.original: Put those tattered threads to use!

43602.original: What persistent pests... Come now, you worthless rugs, shake off that dirt and do something!

43603.original: I've had quite enough of you! I shall like you better set aflame!

43604.original: Your prancing and capering sickens me! Begone from my sight!

43605.original: I tire of this. Go on, you frayed mats─smother the life out of them.

43606.original: Greedy bird! I only stole a few snacks!

43607.original: Hahaha, too slow! That food was delicious, by the way! Until next time!

43609.original: You got in the way of our fun, and now it's time to pay the price!

43610.original: It helped us! Perhaps as a show of thanks for before?

43611.original: Stop struggling! You wear my patience dangerously thin!

43612.original: You'll soon be a pile of ash!

43614.original: Where have I seen this before...? Careful─it appears to be in a foul mood!

43615.original: What? It disappeared? There <hex:021A020203>was<hex:021A020103> a ball of sand over there, right?

43616.original: Wait, the balls are still here, we just can't see them! Remember their position before they turn invisible!

43617.original: It must still be here somewhere! Look carefully for traces of its passage!

43618.original: <cough> <wheeze> ...There you are! Reckoned we'd sit back lickin' our wounds, eh?

43619.original: Time for payback! You'll regret crossin' us!

43620.original: Wh-What's that shakin'!? R-Run! This revenge ain't worth dyin' for!

43621.original: They've run out of eyeshot. I suppose every story needs its petty villains...

43622.original: We slaved for days to make those bombs! Good thing we've got other ways to make you suffer!

43623.original: Godsdammit, why didn't you bring more!? Get the hells out of here!

43624.original: It can turn the seeds invisible too!? Remember where they are!

43625.original: Come, join us. Lend your voice to our chorus!

43626.original: Let our song ring ever louder!

43627.original: More minions! Listen to her voice carefully, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

43628.original: These creatures are different than before... Be wary of their attacks!

43629.original: 歌いましょう、美しき愛が届くように……。

43630.original: They're being guided by her singing. Watch your back!

43631.original: Dance with me. Let the beat of our hearts guide our steps.

43632.original: She's swimming around again. Don't get caught in her wake!

43633.original: Now we offer ourselves to the sea. Hope overflowing coalesces into a wish come true...

43634.original: The orbs are changing─keep an eye on them!

43635.original: Let us shout our prayers to the heavens, and they may be answered.

43636.original: Watch your step! Dense aether yet lingers!

43637.original: You can but walk the path fate sets before you.

43638.original: Surrender yourself to the ocean's embrace.

43639.original: Here comes the wave again! Watch the water carefully!

43640.original: Be buried under the weight of countless unanswered wishes...

43641.original: Let us treasure this bond, ere it vanishes like so much foam upon the tide...

43642.original: Our revel shall not end until our prayers are answered.

43643.original: Do my words not reach you? I ask only that you stay by my side...

43644.original: Now, shall we depart? Into the black, inky depths!

43645.original: ああ……愛しき人……<hex:02100103>あなたも、共には来てくれないのね……。

43652.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, look! That woman is under attack!

43654.original: A beautiful place, to be sure, but sprawling. Perhaps the locals can help us catch the scent of treasure, eh?

43655.original: This must be the heart of the city. We've many roads to choose from. Do any pique your interest?

43656.original: Ah, I see we think alike! Let us proceed.

43657.original: Oh? <hex:021A020203>That<hex:021A020103> way? Well, I'm not one to gainsay an adventurer's intuition, so lead the way!

43658.original: You're fine with me making the choice? Well, my gleaner's intuition is pointing me...this way!

43661.original: ●最初に訪れたのは“正門通り”……

43662.original: Beasts, here!? It looks like they're attacking someone─we must help, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

43663.original: Whenever I draw near the rocks, the fur on my tail stands on end! What could be causing that?

43664.original: A lot of good invisibility did that beast! Watch for shaking flowers─we don't want another surprise!

43665.original: I'm...I'm unharmed, thanks to you. Just who are you, anyways?

43666.original: Hmm... Perhaps you'll find what you seek in the plains to the west. There lies an old abandoned palace, said to house a veritable mountain of treasure.

43667.original: What could be in an abandoned palace but abandoned treasure? Let our search begin in earnest!

43668.original: Shall we travel to the northern valley, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? As insufferable as thieves are, they often hoard treasure!

43669.original: There's nothing like the gentle caress of the wind! And that smell...something sweet is in the air!

43670.original: So that was the scent of apples! I thought so. The orchard keeps going in that direction, it seems.

43671.original: If there's a settlement nearby, someone might be able to point us towards the nearest treasure.

43672.original: I see your thinking: where there's fewer people, there's more hidden treasure to be found!

43673.original: I, for one, could not put a price on a treasure such as this! Let us bring it to the maiden!

43674.original: Exactly the outcome I expected! Even an invisible enemy is no match for your cunning, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

43675.original: This has to be of great value─value immeasurable, one might say! Let us deliver this to the maiden!

43676.original: I must say, that was a grand display! If that genie wasn't trying to kill us, I would certainly watch it again!

43677.original: A new path! It seems the rocks moved... Hmm. Were they imbued with some unseen power?

43678.original: The horizon stretches as far as the eye can see! Oh, is that...? Why, I think it's the palace!

43679.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!? Are you... Oh, can I get down from over there!?

43680.original: Here we are! I expect we'll be accosted soon enough, so be careful!

43681.original: What divine flavor! I scarcely need to chew, and the aroma overwhelms the senses!

43682.original: I can tell you're curious too. My intuition agrees─follow the mushrooms!

43683.original: Are you alright, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!? The railing broke!

43684.original: Are you hurt? To think we would find a path here of all places...

43685.original: The rock is floating in the air! It looked as though some kind of power was being channeled into it...

43686.original: I haven't seen anything quite like this... I believe we have no choice but to get a closer look!

43687.original: It seems with that, all the rocks in the area are floating. I wonder if anything else changed...?

43688.original: That must be one of the legendary swordmasters... Even I can sense she is a formidable foe. But not as formidable as <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103>, I'm sure!

43689.original: That was quite the fight! Despite appearances, her strength was terrifying to behold.

43690.original: It's one of the carpets...she just left it here. Now that I see it up close, 'tis plain it was woven by a master.

43692.original: The damned wheels came right off... Suppose I'll be carrying my haul the rest of the way.

43693.original: Well, we can help with that. If we split the load, we should be able to make it in one go!

43694.original: Say, if I asked you to imagine an object of immeasurable worth, what would come to mind?

43695.original: Looking to make some coin, eh? Hmm. Silk, gemstones, spices. All those would fetch a high price.

43696.original: Come to think of it, I heard sea-folk live in the cove to the east. If anyone had a treasure of singular worth, it would be them.

43697.original: Thank you for that precious morsel of information, my good man! I believe we have our next destination, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

43698.original: Ah, could that be? The Anchorite at Corvos? I read that the rocky formations on both sides of the strait are actually the ankles of a massive statue!

43699.original: I think I'll stay well away from the open sea for some time... Well, let's get to land, yes?

43700.original: Not a single soul to be found...but plainly, this place once thrived.

43701.original: That was─how should I put it?─quite the cheerful adversary. Perhaps it was welcoming us, in its own way...

43702.original: Wait... That carpet. Is it not the selfsame design we saw in the maiden's room?

43703.original: Indeed, it is edible! This unique flavor would make for a perfect spice in certain dishes.

43704.original: Indeed, these waters may hold treasures all their own! I look forward to the sights which await us.

43705.original: Indeed, I see shells and pearls glittering among the sands... All right, lead the way!

43706.original: There's a plate with a matching pattern, too. It's quite dirty, but I think we should take it back with us.

43707.original: The marks of civilization are plain to see. Was this once a place of worship?

43708.original: Are you all right!? To think they would be so bold as to attack on a well-traveled avenue...

43709.original: あれが噂の人魚でしょうか……？<hex:02100103>友好的とは限りません、ご注意ください！

43710.original: We made it! Although the sea-maid tried to kill us, something about her seemed...mournful.

43711.original: Look, she dropped this gem. Its glow is entrancing...'tis probably best not to stare too long.

43712.original: You saved my life, truly. Those thieves but recently began to infest the valley to the north.

43713.original: Did it answer the shell's call? What an adorable thing─and it's colored just like the cove!

43714.original: Oh, most joyful of days! At last, voices from the land call out to me again!

43715.original: Pretty creatures, allow me to guide you. What you seek lies at the end of this path.

43716.original: Yet you must tread carefully. It passes through the territory of a dreadful beast...where my voice will not reach you.

43717.original: Why, she hasn't even bothered to get up! Does she consider us beneath her, or is she just lazy?

43718.original: It seems the carpets do her bidding... Heavens forfend she lift a finger herself!

43719.original: Is that the bird from before!?

43720.original: Now make yourselves useful, you old rags. You <hex:021A020203>do<hex:021A020103> know what I mean, yes?

43721.original: A spirit come to join the fray? Good, good. The lighter my burden, the better.

43722.original: Is that a magic lamp I see!? Just how long was it waiting for us?

43723.original: Welcome, welcome! The guests of honor are here at last!

43724.original: The curtain rises on the big show! Dare not look away, or else!

43725.original: Let us end on a high note! An <hex:021A020203>explosive<hex:021A020103> note!

43726.original: Now we turn up the heat! Do make sure not to get burned!

43727.original: Oh ho, you really know how to put on a show! But I can't let my own guests upstage me!

43728.original: Splendid! Look how they dart about! Be aware that I take no responsibility in case of grievous injury!

43729.original: That was only the opening act! Keep your eyes peeled─you won't want to miss this next part!

43730.original: Keep your wits about you and your eyes sharp! An opening will present itself!

43731.original: What do we have here? Surprise guests! This will be one for the ages!

43732.original: Another foe!? And here I thought the water would be a boon...

43733.original: Now for the fun part! Be dazzled! Be amazed! Be hypnotized!

43734.original: How breathtaking! And...dangerous! Yes, dangerous! Stay focused!

43735.original: That was like seeing two artists at work! My jaw was clenched the whole time...but in the end, you proved the mightier!

43736.original: Why, it's the swordmaster's blade. The edge is flawless, and the decorations are exquisite!

43737.original: Take up your weapon. I pray you can provide some measure of entertainment before you die.

43739.original: Run if you dare! Doom shall find you all the same!

43740.original: Know this: none can escape their fate.
